about_zh: 浏览器里跑的一切，从前端框架到后端服务。

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供交互式开发者成长路线图，涵盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等数十个技术方向，辅以最佳实践指南与面试题库，帮助开发者系统规划职业路径并提升技能。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers interactive developer roadmaps across dozens of tech domains like frontend, backend, DevOps, AI, and data science, along with best practices and interview questions to guide career growth and skill development.

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
repos.summary_en: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

repos.description: This is the repo for Vue 2. For Vue 3, go to https://github.com/vuejs/core
repos.summary_zh: Vue 2 已于2023年12月31日终止维护，不再接收新功能、更新或修复。该仓库为 Vue 2 的归档版本，官方推荐新项目使用 Vue 3.x。Vue 是一个渐进式前端框架，核心库专注视图层，支持逐步采用，并拥有完善的生态系统（如 vue-router、vuex、vue-cli）。
repos.summary_en: Vue 2 reached End of Life on December 31st, 2023 and no longer receives updates. This repository is archived for Vue 2. The actively maintained version is vuejs/core. Vue is a progressive framework for building user interfaces, designed to be incrementally adoptable with a core library focused on the view layer and a rich ecosystem for large-scale applications.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design 是蚂蚁集团开源的企业级 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，提供高质量、可复用的前端组件与完整的设计系统。支持 TypeScript、主题定制、国际化及 SSR，适用于中后台管理系统开发，具备完善的开发工具链和丰富的设计资源。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library developed by Ant Group, offering a comprehensive set of high-quality, customizable components and design resources. Built with TypeScript, it supports internationalization, theme customization, SSR, and modern tooling for efficient enterprise application development.

repos.description: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever.
repos.summary_zh: Material UI 是一个基于 Google Material Design 的 React 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和主题系统，支持无障碍访问和响应式设计。它经过十年开源社区验证，稳定可靠，适合构建现代化 Web 应用，并通过 MUI X 扩展高级组件功能。
repos.summary_en: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library implementing Google's Material Design. It offers battle-tested, accessible, and responsive UI components with a customizable theme system. Trusted by global product teams, it extends functionality via MUI X for advanced use cases.

repos.description: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
repos.summary_zh: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
repos.summary_zh: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
repos.summary_en: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: screenshot-to-code 是一款 AI 驱动的工具，支持将截图、设计稿或 Figma 设计直接转换为高质量的前端代码（HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue），支持 Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 等先进模型，提供实验性视频录制转代码功能，适用于快速原型开发和 UI 自动化生成。
repos.summary_en: screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, mockups, and Figma designs into clean, functional front-end code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). It supports advanced models like Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5, with experimental video-to-code capabilities for rapid prototyping and UI automation.

repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一个专为 AI 前端设计优化的提示工程框架，基于 Anthropic 的 frontend-design 技能扩展而来。它提供 17 个精准指令和 7 个领域专项参考文件，涵盖排版、色彩、动效等设计维度，并内置反模式指南，有效规避模板化设计。支持 Cursor 等 AI 工具，显著提升生成 UI 的专业性与一致性。
repos.summary_en: Impeccable is a prompt engineering framework that enhances AI-driven frontend design by building on Anthropic's frontend-design skill. It offers 17 precise steering commands and 7 domain-specific reference files covering typography, color, motion, and UX writing, plus curated anti-patterns to avoid generic designs. Integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor, it ensures professional, consistent UI output.

repos.description: 🎉 A curated list of awesome things related to Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Vue.js 生态精选资源库，涵盖官方文档、实战教程、UI组件库、企业级应用案例及开发工具，为开发者提供从入门到进阶的完整学习路径与生产级解决方案。
repos.summary_en: A meticulously curated collection of Vue.js resources including official docs, tutorials, UI component libraries, enterprise case studies, and development tools, offering a complete learning path from beginner to production-ready solutions.

repos.description: 🎥      Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: Remotion 是一个基于 React 的视频编程框架，允许开发者使用 Web 技术（如 CSS、Canvas、SVG、WebGL）和 React 组件库来创建动态视频。它支持变量、API 调用、算法等编程能力，适用于个性化视频生成、数据可视化动画等场景，如 GitHub Unwrapped 年度报告。
repos.summary_en: Remotion is a React-based framework for programmatically creating videos using web technologies like CSS, Canvas, SVG, and WebGL. It enables dynamic video generation through programming logic, reusable components, and real-time preview, ideal for personalized content, data-driven animations, and automated video production.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: A Vue.js 2.0 UI Toolkit for Web
repos.summary_zh: Element 是一个基于 Vue.js 2.0 的企业级 UI 组件库，提供丰富的组件和完善的文档支持，适用于中后台管理系统开发。采用模块化设计，支持主题定制，具备完善的国际化方案，并拥有活跃的社区生态。
repos.summary_en: Element is a Vue.js 2.0 UI toolkit for web development, offering a comprehensive set of components and documentation for enterprise-level applications. It features modular architecture, theme customization, full internationalization, and an active community ecosystem.

repos.description: Semantic is a UI component framework based around useful principles from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: Semantic UI 是一个基于自然语言原则的现代化 UI 组件框架，提供 50+ 组件、3000+ CSS 变量和三级变量继承体系，支持 EM 响应式设计和 Flexbox 布局，兼容 React/Angular 等主流框架，助力快速构建美观且可维护的前端界面。
repos.summary_en: Semantic UI is a modern UI component framework based on natural language principles, offering 50+ components, 3000+ CSS variables, and a three-level variable inheritance system. It supports responsive design with EM values and Flexbox, integrates seamlessly with React, Angular, and other frameworks, enabling rapid development of beautiful and maintainable web interfaces.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: 免费大模型API，支持免费调用GPT、DeepSeek等主流模型，免费额度10000点，每日刷新！另付费价格最低官方1-2折！
repos.summary_zh: ChatAnywhere 提供免费 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek API 转发服务，支持 gpt-5、gpt-4o、deepseek-r1/v3、claude、gemini、grok 等主流大模型。采用 OpenAI 标准协议，兼容各类应用，支持流式响应，国内直连无需代理，免费额度每日 200 次（按 IP 和 Key 共享），适合个人非商业用途。
repos.summary_en: ChatAnywhere offers free ChatGPT and DeepSeek API key forwarding services, supporting top-tier models like gpt-5, gpt-4o, deepseek-r1/v3, claude, gemini, and grok. It uses the official OpenAI-compatible protocol, supports streaming responses, and enables direct access from China without proxies. Free tier allows 200 requests/day per IP+Key combination for personal non-commercial use.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: agent-browser 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的高效无头浏览器自动化 CLI 工具，基于原生 Rust 构建。它提供简洁的命令行接口，支持通过元素引用（refs）或传统选择器操作网页，实现点击、填充表单、截图等自动化任务，无需依赖 Playwright 或 Node.js，显著提升 AI 代理的网页交互能力。
repos.summary_en: agent-browser is a high-performance headless browser automation CLI tool designed for AI agents, built with native Rust. It offers an intuitive command-line interface to interact with web pages via element references or traditional selectors, enabling actions like clicking, filling forms, and taking screenshots without requiring Playwright or Node.js, significantly enhancing AI agent web interaction capabilities.

repos.description: A fast, simple & powerful blog framework, powered by Node.js.
repos.summary_zh: Hexo 是一个基于 Node.js 的快速、简洁且强大的博客框架，支持 GitHub Flavored Markdown 和 Octopress 插件，提供一键部署到 GitHub Pages 等功能，拥有强大的 API 和丰富的主题插件生态。
repos.summary_en: Hexo is a fast, simple & powerful blog framework powered by Node.js, supporting GitHub Flavored Markdown and Octopress plugins, with one-command deployment to platforms like GitHub Pages, a robust API, and extensive themes and plugins.

repos.description: Materialize, a CSS Framework based on Material Design
repos.summary_zh: MaterializeCSS 是基于 Material Design 原则构建的现代化 CSS 框架，提供丰富的预构建组件（如导航栏、卡片、表单）和流畅的动画效果，支持响应式布局与主流浏览器兼容，适用于快速开发美观且用户友好的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: MaterializeCSS is a modern CSS framework based on Material Design principles, offering a rich set of pre-built components (e.g., navigation, cards, forms) with smooth animations and responsive layouts, compatible with major browsers for rapid development of visually appealing and user-friendly web applications.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

repos.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
repos.summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
repos.summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

repos.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
repos.summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
repos.summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

repos.description: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
repos.summary_zh: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

repos.description: 网易云音乐 Node.js API service
repos.summary_zh: 网易云音乐 Node.js API 服务，提供音乐播放、歌单获取、用户信息查询等功能，支持无版权限制访问。因版权政策调整，项目已停止维护，建议用户注意合规使用。
repos.summary_en: Netease Cloud Music Node.js API service offering music playback, playlist retrieval, and user data access. Now deprecated due to copyright policy changes; users advised to ensure compliance.

repos.description: A CSS-first, native, zero-build layout and styling framework for web designers.
repos.summary_zh: Yeti 是 Foundation 推出的下一代纯 CSS 布局与样式框架，零构建依赖，基于 CSS Container Queries、Cascade Layers、原生 Nesting 等现代特性驱动。提供意图导向的命名布局、单一 Token 刻度系统与开箱即用的可访问组件，机器可读清单配合 MCP 服务器，面向 2025 基线浏览器优化。
repos.summary_en: Yeti is Foundation's next-gen CSS-first layout and styling framework with zero build requirements, leveraging native CSS features like Container Queries, Cascade Layers, and Nesting. It offers intent-based named layouts, a single token scale system, accessible-by-default components, and a machine-readable manifest with MCP server support, targeting Baseline 2025 browsers.

repos.description: The most advanced responsive front-end framework in the world. Quickly create prototypes and production code for sites that work on any kind of device.
repos.summary_zh: Foundation 是全球最先进的响应式前端框架，支持快速从原型开发到生产环境部署。提供完全可定制的响应式网格系统、丰富的 Sass 混合宏、常用 JavaScript 插件及完整的无障碍访问支持，适用于构建跨设备兼容的网站和应用程序。
repos.summary_en: Foundation is the most advanced responsive front-end framework globally, enabling rapid prototyping and production-ready development of sites and apps that work seamlessly across all devices. It features a fully customizable responsive grid, extensive Sass mixins, essential JavaScript plugins, and comprehensive accessibility support.

repos.description: Documentation that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
repos.summary_en: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
repos.summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

repos.description: The Developer Tool for Visual Engineers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers and Visual Engineers to design with Real Code.
repos.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

repos.description: ⭐⭐⭐⭐秒杀系统设计与实现.互联网工程师进阶与分析🙋🐓
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库聚焦秒杀系统的高并发设计与实现，涵盖Spring、Redis、MQ、ZK等核心技术栈，提供完整的高可用、高性能解决方案。项目包含多线程导入框架、JVM调优实战、分布式流程引擎等进阶内容，适合中高级工程师系统学习互联网架构核心能力。
repos.summary_en: This repository focuses on high-concurrency design and implementation of flash sale systems, covering core tech stacks like Spring, Redis, MQ, and ZooKeeper. It provides complete solutions for high availability and performance, including multi-threaded import frameworks, JVM tuning, and distributed workflow engines, ideal for intermediate to advanced engineers.

repos.description: For slim progress bars like on YouTube, Medium, etc
repos.summary_zh: NProgress 是一个轻量级进度条库，专为 Ajax 应用设计，灵感来自 YouTube、Medium 等网站。它提供极简的 API 控制进度条，支持 Turbolinks、Pjax 等现代前端框架集成，并允许自定义配置如最小值、动画速度和模板。
repos.summary_en: NProgress is a minimalist progress bar library for Ajax applications, inspired by YouTube and Medium. It offers a simple API to control the bar, integrates with frameworks like Turbolinks and Pjax, and supports customization of minimum value, animation speed, and template.

repos.description: Bootstrap 5 & Material Design UI KIT
repos.summary_zh: MDBootstrap 提供基于 Bootstrap 5 和 Material Design 的免费 UI 组件库，包含 700+ 原生 JavaScript 组件，支持 npm、CDN 和 Webpack 集成，适用于快速构建现代化网页界面，被 NASA、Nike 等企业广泛使用。
repos.summary_en: MDBootstrap offers a free UI kit with 700+ Bootstrap 5 components based on Material Design, built in plain JavaScript. It supports npm, CDN, and Webpack integration, enabling rapid development of modern web interfaces trusted by 3M+ developers and enterprises like NASA and Nike.

repos.description: A high quality UI Toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0
repos.summary_zh: iView 是基于 Vue.js 2.0 开发的高质量 UI 组件库，提供数十个美观实用的组件，支持 Vue 1.x 和 2.x、SSR、TypeScript、Electron 等，适用于企业级应用开发，文档详尽且提供丰富示例。
repos.summary_en: iView is a high-quality UI toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0, offering dozens of beautiful and practical components. It supports Vue 1.x/2.x, SSR, TypeScript, Electron, and provides extensive documentation with demos for enterprise-level applications.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 一个包含1324种健身动作的结构化多语言数据集，涵盖类别、目标肌群、器械、多语言指令及媒体ID。提供开发者向导，便于快速搭建健身应用后端、数据库及API。数据源自ExerciseDB，支持6种语言，适合健身应用开发、AI推荐及健康研究。
repos.summary_en: A structured multilingual dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises with categories, target muscles, equipment, step-by-step instructions in 6 languages, and media IDs. Includes a developer setup wizard for rapid backend, database, and API scaffolding. Ideal for fitness app development, AI recommendations, and health research.

repos.description: 没事写写文章，喜欢的话请点star，想订阅点watch，千万别fork！
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是作者个人技术博客，专注于前端工程化实践与性能优化，涵盖前端集成、模块化开发、自动化测试、部署流程等核心议题，并收录业界最佳实践与经典技术文章，适合前端工程师系统性提升工程能力。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a personal technical blog focused on front-end engineering, covering topics like integration, modular development, automated testing, and deployment. It includes industry best practices and classic articles to help front-end engineers enhance their engineering capabilities.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: 全栈工程师培训材料
repos.summary_zh: 全栈工程师培训材料，系统讲解JavaScript全栈开发技术，涵盖前端React、Node.js后端及工程化实践，适合有HTML/CSS/JS基础的学习者，通过四讲课程帮助掌握Web应用前后端开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Comprehensive full-stack JavaScript training material covering frontend React, Node.js backend development, and engineering practices. Designed for learners with basic HTML/CSS/JS knowledge, featuring four lectures for a two-day bootcamp on building complete web applications.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: pushState + ajax = pjax
repos.summary_zh: pjax 是一个 jQuery 插件，通过结合 pushState 和 ajax 技术，实现无刷新页面跳转，提升浏览体验。它支持动态加载 HTML 内容并更新浏览器地址栏，避免资源重复加载，适用于需要快速响应的单页应用。
repos.summary_en: pjax is a jQuery plugin that combines pushState and ajax to enable fast, seamless page navigation without full reloads. It dynamically loads HTML content, updates the browser URL, and preserves permalinks, titles, and back-button functionality for enhanced user experience.

repos.description: Mobile UI elements for Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Mint UI 是一个专为 Vue 2.0 设计的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的移动端常用组件，支持全局注册和按需引入，具备轻量、模块化、易集成的特点，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Mint UI is a mobile-first UI component library for Vue 2.0, offering a suite of mobile-optimized components. It supports global registration and modular imports, with features like lightweight design, modularity, and easy integration, ideal for rapid mobile web development.

repos.description: a collection of simple demos of React.js
repos.summary_zh: 阮一峰 React.js 简易演示集，通过 13 个清晰示例系统讲解 React 核心概念，涵盖 JSX 语法、组件开发、状态管理、生命周期、表单处理及 Ajax 等，适合初学者快速上手 React 开发。
repos.summary_en: A collection of simple React.js demos by Ruan YiFeng, covering core concepts like JSX, components, state management, lifecycle, forms, and Ajax through 13 clear examples, ideal for beginners to learn React effectively.

repos.description: Material design for AngularJS
repos.summary_zh: AngularJS Material 是 Google Material Design 规范在 AngularJS (v1.x) 中的官方实现，提供轻量级、可复用的 UI 组件库，支持响应式布局和无障碍访问。项目已于2022年终止维护，推荐迁移至 Angular Material (v2+) 版本。
repos.summary_en: AngularJS Material is the official implementation of Google's Material Design specification for AngularJS (v1.x), offering a lightweight set of reusable, accessible UI components. Support ended in January 2022; users are advised to migrate to Angular Material (v2+).

repos.description: Create web-based user interfaces with Python. The nice way.
repos.summary_zh: NiceGUI是一个基于Python的轻量级Web UI框架，通过纯Python代码快速构建按钮、图表、3D场景等交互界面。内置热重载、定时器刷新与数据绑定，支持浏览器访问与原生桌面模式，适用于仪表板、机器人控制和ML调参等场景。
repos.summary_en: NiceGUI is a lightweight Python-based framework for building interactive web UIs with buttons, charts, and 3D scenes. It features auto-reload, timers, data binding, and supports both browser and desktop modes—ideal for dashboards, robotics, and ML tuning.

repos.description: Elegant theme for Hexo.
repos.summary_zh: NexT 是一个高质量、优雅的 Hexo 主题，提供 Muse、Mist、Pisces 和 Gemini 四种精美配色方案，支持高度自定义配置，适用于个人博客与静态网站搭建。
repos.summary_en: NexT is a high-quality, elegant Hexo theme featuring four distinct color schemes (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini) with extensive customization options, ideal for personal blogs and static site generation.

repos.description: Automatically add a progress bar to your site.
repos.summary_zh: PACE 是一个自动为网站添加进度条的轻量级 JavaScript 库，无需手动配置即可通过监控 Ajax 请求、事件循环延迟、文档就绪状态和页面元素来智能计算加载进度，支持多种主题样式和自定义配置，适用于提升用户页面加载体验。
repos.summary_en: PACE is a lightweight JavaScript library that automatically adds a progress bar to websites. It intelligently monitors Ajax requests, event loop lag, document readiness, and page elements to calculate loading progress without manual setup, featuring multiple themes and customizable options for enhanced user experience.

repos.description: Themes for Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: Bootswatch 提供一系列开源的 Bootstrap 主题，支持通过预编译 CSS、CDN、Sass 导入、npm 包或 Ruby Gem 集成到项目中，适用于快速美化网页界面，支持主题定制与变量覆盖。
repos.summary_en: Bootswatch offers a collection of open-source themes for Bootstrap, enabling easy integration via pre-compiled CSS, CDN, Sass imports, npm packages, or Ruby Gem. It supports theme customization and variable overrides for rapid UI enhancement.

repos.description: PLEASE READ THE PROJECT STATUS BELOW.  Native AngularJS (Angular) directives for Bootstrap. Smaller footprint (20kB gzipped), no 3rd party JS dependencies (jQuery, bootstrap JS) required. Please read the README.md file before submitting an issue!
repos.summary_zh: UI Bootstrap 是专为 AngularJS 设计的原生指令库，提供 Bootstrap 组件的轻量实现（仅20kB gzipped），无需依赖 jQuery 或 Bootstrap 的 JavaScript。项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至 ng-bootstrap 以支持 Angular 2+。核心优势包括模块化构建、与 AngularJS 深度集成及完善的动画支持。
repos.summary_en: UI Bootstrap provides native AngularJS directives for Bootstrap components with a minimal footprint (20kB gzipped), requiring no jQuery or Bootstrap JS dependencies. The project is now feature-complete and unmaintained, with migration to ng-bootstrap recommended for Angular 2+ users. Key features include modular builds, deep AngularJS integration, and ngAnimate support.

repos.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

repos.description: 最接近原生APP体验的高性能框架
repos.summary_zh: mui 是一个专为移动端 HTML5 应用设计的高性能框架，有效解决了浏览器原生体验差的问题，如白屏、动画卡顿、下拉刷新不流畅等。它提供接近原生 APP 的流畅交互与丰富 UI 控件，支持与 HBuilder 开发工具深度集成，显著提升移动端 Web 应用开发效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: mui is a high-performance framework for mobile HTML5 apps, addressing core issues like page flickering, poor animations, and unsmooth pull-to-refresh. It delivers near-native app experiences with rich UI components and seamless integration with HBuilder, enabling efficient development of smooth, visually appealing mobile web applications.

repos.description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
repos.summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: An extended table for integration with some of the most widely used CSS frameworks. (Supports Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, Material Design, Foundation, Vue.js)
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Table 是一个功能强大的表格扩展插件，支持 Bootstrap、Semantic UI、Bulma、Material Design 等主流 CSS 框架。提供排序、分页、筛选、多选、卡片视图、详情视图等丰富功能，支持 AJAX 数据加载、本地化和扩展机制，适用于数据展示与交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Table is a feature-rich table extension for popular CSS frameworks like Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, and Material Design. It offers sorting, pagination, filtering, row selection, card/detail views, AJAX data loading, localization, and extensibility, making it ideal for dynamic data presentation and interaction.

repos.description: 在Github的学习片段
repos.summary_zh: MarkYun Bolg 是一个 GitHub 托管的个人技术博客，涵盖前端开发、摄影等内容。作者为南京 Web 开发者，定期更新前端面试题与 Web 技术周刊，提供学习记录与技术见解，支持 Star 与 Issue 互动。
repos.summary_en: MarkYun Bolg is a GitHub-hosted personal blog by a Nanjing-based Web Developer, covering front-end development, photography, and technical insights. It features updated front-end interview questions and a weekly Web intelligence newsletter, encouraging community engagement via Star and Issue submissions.

repos.description: JavaScript Date Range, Date and Time Picker Component
repos.summary_zh: Date Range Picker 是一个功能强大的 JavaScript 日期时间选择组件，支持日期范围选择、单日期模式、时间选择及预设范围，具备灵活的日期限制、本地化支持和多种日期格式，适用于报表筛选等场景。
repos.summary_en: Date Range Picker is a robust JavaScript component for selecting date ranges or single dates with time selection, predefined ranges, localization, and customizable date constraints, ideal for reporting and data filtering interfaces.

repos.description: This is a Next.js, Tailwind CSS blogging starter template. Comes out of the box configured with the latest technologies to make technical writing a breeze. Easily configurable and customizable. Perfect as a replacement to existing Jekyll and Hugo individual blogs.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 博客模板，基于 App Router 和 React Server Components，集成 Contentlayer 管理 Markdown 内容。开箱即用，支持高度可定制，适合替代 Jekyll 和 Hugo 个人博客，提供现代化的技术写作体验。
repos.summary_en: A feature-rich Next.js and Tailwind CSS blogging starter template based on the App Router and React Server Components, using Contentlayer for markdown content management. Fully configured out-of-the-box, highly customizable, and ideal for replacing Jekyll and Hugo personal blogs with modern technical writing capabilities.

repos.description: Practice English, one strike, one step forward
repos.summary_zh: TypeWords 是一款开源英语单词与文章练习工具，基于 Nuxt 构建。支持跟读、听写、自测、默写等多种模式，内置 CET-4/6、雅思、托福等主流词库，通过艾宾浩斯记忆曲线智能规划学习，提供双语对照与发音跟读，界面简洁无广告，数据本地存储。
repos.summary_en: TypeWords is an open-source English vocabulary and article practice tool built with Nuxt. It supports follow-along, dictation, self-test, and memory typing modes, with built-in word banks for CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL and more. Features spaced repetition algorithms, bilingual comparison, pronunciation playback, and a clean ad-free interface with local data storage.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: 一个简洁优雅的hexo主题  A simple and elegant theme for hexo.
repos.summary_zh: Yilia 是一款为 Hexo 博客系统设计的简洁优雅主题，注重移动端体验与极致加载性能，支持目录导航、打赏、搜索、分享等功能，采用 webpack 构建，强调内容呈现与用户专注度。
repos.summary_en: Yilia is a simple and elegant theme for Hexo 2.4+, focusing on mobile experience, fast loading, and content-first design. It supports features like TOC, rewards, search, sharing, and is built with webpack for performance and extensibility.

repos.description: Elegant and powerful theme for Hexo.
repos.summary_zh: NexT 是一款优雅且功能强大的 Hexo 主题，专为静态博客设计。支持多风格（Muse、Mist、Pisces、Gemini），集成 PJAX 加速、CDN 配置、第三方插件扩展等高级功能，注重代码高亮、响应式布局与 SEO 优化，适合技术博客与个人站点。
repos.summary_en: NexT is an elegant and powerful theme for Hexo, designed for static blogs. It offers multiple styles (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini), supports advanced features like PJAX navigation, CDN integration, and third-party plugins, with strong emphasis on code highlighting, responsive design, and SEO optimization for tech blogs and personal sites.

repos.description: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
repos.summary_zh: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
repos.summary_en: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

repos.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

repos.description: 一个简单的本地网页界面，使用ChatTTS将文字合成为语音，同时支持对外提供API接口。A simple native web interface that uses ChatTTS to synthesize text into speech, along with support for external API interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: ChatTTS-ui 是一个本地网页界面，基于 ChatTTS 模型实现文字转语音功能，支持中英文及数字混合文本合成，并提供 API 接口供外部调用。支持 Windows 预打包版、Linux 容器及源码部署，兼容 CPU/GPU 加速（NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD ROCm），首次运行自动下载模型文件。
repos.summary_en: ChatTTS-ui is a local web interface that uses the ChatTTS model to synthesize text into speech, supporting mixed Chinese-English text and numbers, with external API support. It offers pre-packaged Windows version, Linux container deployment, and source code setup, with CPU/GPU acceleration via NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm, and automatic model download on first run.

repos.description: The mobile-friendly, responsive, and lightweight jQuery date & time input picker.
repos.summary_zh: pickadate.js 是一个轻量级、响应式且移动端友好的 jQuery 日期和时间选择器库，支持多种主题和语言翻译，提供灵活的 API 和 LESS 样式定制能力，适用于现代化 Web 表单交互。
repos.summary_en: pickadate.js is a lightweight, responsive, and mobile-friendly jQuery date & time picker library with support for multiple themes, language translations, and customizable LESS-based styling, ideal for modern web form inputs.

repos.description: It's a new file uploader solution!
repos.summary_zh: WebUploader 是一个基于 HTML5 为主、Flash 为辅的现代文件上传组件，兼容 IE6+ 及移动端。支持大文件分片并发上传、图片预览压缩、拖拽粘贴添加文件，并提供 MD5 秒传与模块化扩展能力，显著提升上传效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: WebUploader is a modern file uploader built primarily on HTML5 with Flash fallback, supporting IE6+ and mobile browsers. It enables chunked concurrent uploads, image preview/compression, drag-and-drop/paste file addition, MD5 instant upload, and modular extensibility for enhanced performance and flexibility.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是阿里无线前端团队2015年的技术文章合集，涵盖性能优化、H5适配、动态化方案、图标与字体处理等核心议题，包含双11项目总结与Flexible适配实践，体现了手淘前端在电商场景下的深度技术探索与工程实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains technical articles from Alibaba's mobile front-end team in 2015, covering performance optimization, H5 adaptation, dynamic solutions, icon/font handling, and e-commerce-specific challenges, including insights from Double 11 projects and Flexible layout practices.

repos.description: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
repos.summary_zh: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

repos.description: This is a repository for collecting global custom management extensions for the Django Framework.
repos.summary_zh: Django Extensions 是一个为 Django 框架提供增强功能的扩展集合，包含模型可视化、URL 路由分析、模板验证、增强版 shell_plus 和 runserver_plus 等实用工具，显著提升开发效率与调试体验。
repos.summary_en: Django Extensions is a collection of custom management extensions for Django, offering tools like model graphing, URL inspection, template validation, shell_plus, and runserver_plus to enhance developer productivity and debugging workflows.

repos.description: Simple forum software for building great communities.
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一个轻量级、现代化的论坛软件，专为构建高效社区而设计。基于 PHP 开发，采用 Mithril 前端框架，具备简洁界面、快速部署和强大扩展能力，支持插件化定制，适用于各类在线讨论场景。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a lightweight, modern forum software designed to build great online communities. Built with PHP and powered by the Mithril JavaScript framework, it offers a clean interface, fast deployment, and extensive extensibility through a robust Extension API, ideal for customizable discussion platforms.

repos.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
repos.summary_zh: 赫蹏（Heti）是一款专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强库。它基于通行的中文排版规范，提供贴合网格的排版、全标签美化、古文诗词样式及竖排等功能。通过引入CSS与可选的JS脚本，可自动实现中西文混排优化与全角标点挤压，大幅提升网页中文阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: Heti is a typography enhancement library specifically designed for Chinese content display. Based on standard Chinese typesetting conventions, it offers grid-aligned layouts, full tag styling, and specialized formats for classical poetry and vertical writing. By including its CSS and optional JS, it automatically optimizes CJK-Latin mixed spacing and punctuation compression, significantly improving the reading experience.

repos.description: Curated list of apps and tools that not only use the new ChatGPT API, but also allow users to configure their own API keys, enabling free and on-demand usage of their own quota.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome ChatGPT API 是一个精心策划的资源列表，汇集了支持用户自定义 API 密钥的应用和工具，实现免费按需调用自有配额。涵盖浏览器插件、Web/桌面应用、CLI 工具及开发资源，适用于多场景 AI 集成，如翻译、搜索摘要、代码辅助等，助力开发者构建高效 ChatGPT 生态。
repos.summary_en: Awesome ChatGPT API is a curated collection of apps and tools that support custom API key configuration, enabling free on-demand usage of personal quotas. It includes browser extensions, web/desktop apps, CLI tools, and development resources, supporting diverse AI integrations like translation, search summarization, and code assistance for building a robust ChatGPT ecosystem.

repos.description: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
repos.summary_zh: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

repos.description: A Flutter UI Kit（一个 Flutter UI组件库），包含 ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, WaterMark, GradientCircularProgressIndicator...
repos.summary_zh: Flukit 是一个功能丰富的 Flutter UI 组件库，提供 ScaleView、Swiper、PullRefresh、WaterMark 等实用 Widget，涵盖手势交互、动画效果、进度指示器等场景，支持自定义渐变按钮、弹性滚动头部等高级功能，显著提升 Flutter 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Flukit is a comprehensive Flutter UI kit offering essential widgets like ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, and WaterMark. It supports advanced features such as gesture interactions, gradient animations, elastic headers, and progress indicators, significantly enhancing Flutter app development efficiency.

repos.description: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
repos.summary_zh: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: Collection of material design libs and res.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome-MaterialDesign 是一个精选的 Android Material Design 资源与库集合，涵盖官方文档、Google 示例项目、设计资源及第三方开源库，为开发者提供从设计规范到 UI 组件实现的完整解决方案，助力快速构建符合 Material Design 标准的 Android 应用。
repos.summary_en: Awesome-MaterialDesign is a curated collection of Android Material Design resources and libraries, including official docs, Google sample projects, design assets, and third-party open-source libraries, providing a complete solution for developers to build Material Design-compliant Android apps efficiently.

repos.description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

repos.description: an elegant efficient express mvvm framework
repos.summary_zh: Avalon2 是一个高效优雅的 MVVM 前端框架，支持双向数据绑定与组件化开发，具备优异的渲染性能与后端渲染能力。它兼容 IE6+，提供丰富的指令系统（如 ms-duplex、ms-if）和组件开发支持，适用于构建高性能单页应用（SPA）。
repos.summary_en: Avalon2 is an elegant and efficient MVVM framework for frontend development, featuring two-way data binding, componentization, and high-performance rendering. It supports server-side rendering, IE6+ compatibility, and provides a rich directive system (e.g., ms-duplex, ms-if) for building scalable single-page applications (SPAs).

repos.description: The open source Trello alternative.
repos.summary_zh: Kan是一个开源的Trello替代方案，采用Next.js与tRPC技术栈构建，支持看板权限控制、团队协作者邀请、Trello一键导入、标签筛选、活动日志追踪及自定义模板等功能，提供Railway一键部署与Docker Compose自托管两种方案，适合中小团队进行轻量级项目管理与任务协作。
repos.summary_en: Kan is an open-source Trello alternative built with Next.js and tRPC, offering board visibility control, team collaboration, Trello imports, labels, activity logs, and templates. Supports Railway one-click deployment and Docker self-hosting, ideal for small to medium teams seeking lightweight project management and task collaboration.

repos.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
repos.summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
repos.summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

repos.description: Django app for handling the server headers required for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
repos.summary_zh: django-cors-headers 是一个 Django 应用，用于自动为响应添加跨域资源共享（CORS）头，支持灵活配置允许的源、方法和头部，适用于前后端分离架构中安全地允许跨域请求。
repos.summary_en: django-cors-headers is a Django app that automatically adds Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers to responses, enabling secure cross-origin requests from browsers with configurable origins, methods, and headers.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

repos.description: CSS library for Instagram filters
repos.summary_zh: CSSgram 是一个基于 Sass 和 CSS 的 Instagram 滤镜库，通过 CSS 伪元素和混合模式为网页图片添加 Instagram 风格滤镜效果，支持 24 种经典滤镜（如 Aden、1977、Brooklyn 等），无需图像处理工具即可实现丰富的视觉风格，适用于现代浏览器（Chrome 43+、Firefox 38+ 等）。
repos.summary_en: CSSgram is a Sass and CSS library that applies Instagram-like filters to images using CSS filters and blend modes via pseudo-elements. It offers 24 presets (e.g., Aden, 1977, Brooklyn) for web-based image styling without manual editing, compatible with modern browsers (Chrome 43+, Firefox 38+, etc.).

repos.description: Wrappers for JavaScript alert(), confirm() and other flexible dialogs using Twitter's bootstrap framework
repos.summary_zh: Bootbox 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 框架的 JavaScript 对话框封装库，提供简洁易用的 alert()、confirm() 等弹窗接口，支持高度定制化与响应式设计，适用于现代 Web 应用的用户交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootbox is a JavaScript library that wraps native alert(), confirm(), and other dialog functions using Twitter's Bootstrap framework, offering customizable, responsive modal dialogs for modern web applications.

repos.description: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
repos.summary_zh: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
repos.summary_en: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: A generic system for filtering Django QuerySets based on user selections
repos.summary_zh: Django-filter 是一个用于在 Django 中基于用户选择动态过滤 QuerySet 的通用应用，支持通过 URL 参数生成类似 admin 的筛选界面，提供类似 ModelForms 的声明式 API，并深度集成 Django REST Framework，适用于构建灵活的数据筛选接口。
repos.summary_en: Django-filter is a reusable Django application that enables declarative dynamic QuerySet filtering via URL parameters, offering an API similar to ModelForms. It supports admin-like filtering interfaces and integrates seamlessly with Django REST Framework for building flexible data filtering endpoints.

repos.description: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
repos.summary_en: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

repos.description: 中文网页重设与排版 CSS，面向现代中文阅读优化字体、行高、CJK 断行、中西文间距与着重号。
repos.summary_zh: typo.css 是一个专为中文网页设计的样式重置与排版工具，旨在统一浏览器渲染差异，优化中文阅读体验。它提供完整的 reset 样式、阅读内容排版类 `.typo` 及专名号、着重号等中文排版增强功能，支持桌面与移动端，适用于文章、文档等长文本场景。
repos.summary_en: typo.css is a CSS framework designed for Chinese web typography, aiming to standardize browser rendering and optimize readability. It offers a complete reset, a `.typo` class for article layouts, and enhancements like underlines for proper nouns and emphasis marks, supporting both desktop and mobile platforms.

repos.description: Lightweight CSS framework
repos.summary_zh: MUI 是一个轻量级 CSS 框架，严格遵循 Google 的 Material Design 设计规范，提供响应式网格系统、无依赖组件和邮件样式支持，核心优势在于极小的体积（CSS 6.6KB，JS 5.4KB）和高度可定制性，适合快速构建现代化网页界面。
repos.summary_en: MUI is a lightweight CSS framework adhering to Google's Material Design guidelines, offering a responsive grid, zero dependencies, customizable styling, and email support. Key strengths include minimal footprint (6.6KB CSS, 5.4KB JS gzipped) and async JS loading for fast, modern web development.

repos.description: Quick and easy product tours with Twitter Bootstrap Popovers
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tour 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap Popovers 的快速易用的产品引导工具，专为构建交互式用户引导流程设计。支持 Bootstrap 2.3.0+ 版本，提供灵活的 API 和丰富的配置选项，适用于提升用户体验和引导新用户。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tour is a quick and easy product tour library built on Twitter Bootstrap Popovers, designed to create interactive onboarding experiences. Compatible with Bootstrap >= 2.3.0, it offers a flexible API and extensive configuration options for guiding users through applications.

repos.description: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
repos.summary_zh: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
repos.summary_en: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

repos.description: High-crafted UI libraries for AI agents: Border beam, Orbs, Metal, Gooey, Voice, Image, Avatar bots
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的高品质 React UI 特效库集合，包含 border-beam 动态边框光束、liquid-gooey 液态流体效果和 thinking-orbs 点阵加载动画。支持 React Native 与 SwiftUI 跨平台复用，采用 npm workspaces 多包管理，提供可视化演示站点与 CI 自动化发布流程。
repos.summary_en: High-quality React UI effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted orb loaders. Supports cross-platform React Native and SwiftUI ports. Built with npm workspaces for multi-package management, including hot-reload development and automated CI deployment.

repos.description: A lightweight Vue.js UI library with a simple API, inspired by Google's Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Keen UI 是一个轻量级 Vue.js 3 UI 组件库，采用简洁 API 设计，灵感来自 Google Material Design。它专注于交互式 JavaScript 组件，不依赖 CSS 框架，支持自定义主题与尺寸，并提供独立组件打包方案以优化体积。
repos.summary_en: Keen UI is a lightweight Vue.js 3 UI library featuring a simple API inspired by Google's Material Design. It focuses on interactive JavaScript-driven components without bundling CSS frameworks, supports theme and sizing customization, and offers standalone component builds for bundle optimization.

repos.description: Material Design theme for hexo.
repos.summary_zh: Material Theme 是一款专为 Hexo 博客框架设计的纯净 Material Design 风格主题，支持响应式布局和现代化 UI 交互。提供多版本下载（稳定版/开发版/历史版），集成 BrowserStack 浏览器兼容测试与 jsDelivr CDN 加速服务，具备完善的文档与社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Material Theme is a pure Material Design theme for Hexo, featuring responsive layouts and modern UI interactions. It offers multiple download versions (stable/canary/historical), integrates BrowserStack for cross-browser testing, and uses jsDelivr CDN for fast asset delivery, backed by comprehensive documentation and community support.

repos.description: Per object permissions for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-guardian 是 Django 的细粒度对象权限管理库，通过扩展 Django 的授权后端实现基于对象的权限控制。支持为单个模型实例分配权限，适用于需要复杂权限模型的应用场景，如多租户系统或内容协作平台。
repos.summary_en: django-guardian is a Django library implementing per-object permissions by extending Django's authorization backend. It enables fine-grained access control at the object level, allowing assignment of permissions to individual model instances—ideal for multi-tenant or collaborative applications requiring complex permission models.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: 表白代码收藏馆~谁说程序猿不懂浪漫❤️
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Love Code 是一个创意表白代码集合项目，汇集多种网页表白特效，涵盖动画、交互、音乐等元素，为开发者提供浪漫表白的技术实现方案，展现程序员表达爱意的独特方式。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Love Code is a curated collection of romantic coding projects featuring web-based confession effects with animations, interactions, and music. It showcases how programmers express love through creative technical implementations.

repos.description: Simple tagging for django
repos.summary_zh: django-taggit 是一个为 Django 框架提供的简洁高效的标签管理库，支持通过 TaggableManager 轻松为模型添加标签功能，兼容 Django 3.2+，提供 API 操作、表单集成和后台管理支持，适用于内容分类与检索场景。
repos.summary_en: django-taggit is a simple and efficient tagging library for Django, enabling easy tag management via TaggableManager. It supports Django 3.2+, offers API-driven tag operations, form integration, and admin support, ideal for content categorization and retrieval.

repos.description: Super tiny size multi-touch gestures library for the web. 　　　You can touch this →
repos.summary_zh: AlloyFinger 是一个超轻量级的多点触控手势库，专为网页设计，支持触摸、滑动、缩放、旋转等手势识别。采用模块化设计，体积小巧，API 简洁易用，兼容主流框架（如 Omi），适用于移动端和桌面端交互场景。
repos.summary_en: AlloyFinger is a super lightweight multi-touch gesture library for the web, supporting gestures like touch, swipe, pinch, and rotate. It features a modular design, small size, simple API, and compatibility with frameworks like Omi, ideal for mobile and desktop interactive applications.

repos.description: Trying to complete over 100 projects in various categories in golang.
repos.summary_zh: 《Go实战开发》是一本通过100+实战项目系统学习Go语言的书籍，涵盖Web开发、网络编程、数据库操作等全场景。作者astaxie结合PHP开发经验，以项目驱动方式帮助开发者掌握Go核心特性与工程实践，配套开源代码与社区支持，适合中高级开发者进阶。
repos.summary_en: 《Go实战开发》 is a project-driven book teaching Go through 100+ practical projects across categories like web development and networking. Authored by astaxie, it leverages PHP experience to guide developers in mastering Go's core features and engineering practices, with open-source code and community support for advanced learning.

repos.description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Tavily、Cursor 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 架构，具备插件化扩展能力，集成邮箱服务（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码识别（YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox）及代理池管理功能，提供实时日志推送的 Web UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account auto-registration and management system supporting major AI platforms like Trae.ai, Tavily, and Cursor. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving (YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox), proxy pool management, and real-time log streaming via SSE to a web UI.

repos.description: Django application and library for importing and exporting data with admin integration.
repos.summary_zh: django-import-export 是一个专为 Django 应用设计的强大数据导入导出库，支持 CSV、Excel、JSON 等多种格式，提供 Admin 后台集成和编程接口。核心功能包括数据预览、批量导入、CRUD 操作控制、外键与多对多关系处理、数据验证及自定义转换，适用于需要高效处理大规模数据迁移或批量操作的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-import-export is a robust Django library for importing and exporting data across multiple formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, etc.). It offers seamless Admin UI integration and programmatic access, featuring data preview, bulk import, CRUD control, foreign key/many-to-many relation handling, validation, and custom transformations—ideal for data migration and batch operations in Django applications.

repos.description: 翻译自Miguel Grinberg的blog https://blog.miguelgrinberg.com 的2017年新版The Flask Mega-Tutorial教程
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 Miguel Grinberg 《The Flask Mega-Tutorial》2017年版的完整中文翻译，涵盖从基础到部署的全栈开发实践。通过23章系统讲解 Flask 框架核心功能，包括模板、表单、数据库、用户认证、Ajax、全文搜索、国际化及多平台部署（Linux/Heroku/Docker），适合中高级开发者构建复杂 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains the complete Chinese translation of Miguel Grinberg's 2017 'The Flask Mega-Tutorial', covering full-stack web development with Flask from basics to deployment. Spanning 23 chapters, it systematically teaches core Flask features including templating, forms, databases, authentication, Ajax, full-text search, internationalization, and multi-platform deployment (Linux/Heroku/Docker), ideal for intermediate to advanced developers building complex web applications.

repos.description: JSON Web Token Authentication support for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为 Django REST Framework 提供 JSON Web Token (JWT) 身份验证支持，实现无状态用户认证。适用于需要安全、可扩展 API 的场景，如前后端分离应用。现已停止维护，建议使用官方或活跃替代方案。
repos.summary_en: This package adds JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication support for Django REST Framework, enabling stateless API security. Ideal for modern web applications requiring secure, scalable authentication. Note: Project is unmaintained; alternatives recommended.

repos.description: Full featured redis cache backend for Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-redis 是一个功能完整的 Redis 缓存和会话后端，专为 Django 设计。它支持原生 redis-py URL 连接字符串、可插拔客户端/解析器/序列化器，提供主从支持、无限超时、Unix 套接字连接及原始 Redis 客户端访问，适用于高并发生产环境。
repos.summary_en: django-redis is a full-featured, BSD-licensed Redis cache and session backend for Django. It supports native redis-py URL connections, pluggable clients/parsers/serializers, primary/secondary setups, infinite timeouts, Unix sockets, and raw Redis client access, making it ideal for production-scale Django applications.

repos.description: Legacy code of V2EX running on Google App Engine
repos.summary_zh: Project Babel 2 是基于 Python 和 Google App Engine 的开源社区建站系统，专为构建类似 V2EX 的分享与发现型社区设计。支持节点分类、多主题管理、响应式主题、WebDAV 头像托管、Atom 订阅、HTML5 兼容、MapReduce 数据优化及 Twitter OAuth 集成，具备高性能扩展能力，支持百万级日访问量。
repos.summary_en: Project Babel 2 is an open-source community platform built with Python on Google App Engine, designed for sharing and discovery communities like V2EX. It features node-based organization, responsive themes, WebDAV avatars, Atom feeds, HTML5 support, MapReduce data optimization, and Twitter OAuth integration, capable of scaling to millions of daily pageviews with proper configuration.

repos.description: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
repos.summary_en: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

repos.description: weui for react
repos.summary_zh: React-WeUI 是基于 React 框架封装的 WeUI 组件库，提供与微信原生 UI 风格一致的移动端界面组件，支持 npm 安装与 CDN 引用，具备完善的文档与示例，适用于快速构建移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: React-WeUI is a React-based component library implementing WeUI's native WeChat UI design, enabling rapid development of mobile web interfaces with npm installation, CDN support, and comprehensive documentation.

repos.description: Collection of effects for React: Border beam, Liquid Gooey, Thinking orbs
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供两个 React UI 动效组件库：border-beam 实现流光边框动画，liquid-gooey 提供液态变形与流动特效。适用于现代 Web 应用视觉增强，支持源码热更新、独立 npm 发布与 CI 构建部署。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides two React UI animation libraries: border-beam for glowing border effects and liquid-gooey for morphing blob animations. Built with npm workspaces, supporting hot-reload source editing, independent package publishing, and automated CI deployment for modern web visual enhancement.

repos.description: Django social authentication made simple
repos.summary_zh: Django Social Auth 是一个为 Django 项目提供社交登录功能的库，支持 Google、Facebook、Twitter 等 40+ 主流平台的 OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID 认证。它基于 python-social-auth 构建，提供用户注册、多账号关联、自定义用户模型和认证管道扩展等核心能力，现已被官方标记为弃用状态。
repos.summary_en: Django Social Auth is a deprecated library enabling social login via OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID for Django projects. It supports 40+ providers including Google, Facebook, and Twitter, offering user registration, multi-account association, custom user models, and extensible authentication pipelines. Now superseded by python-social-auth.

repos.description: Swagger Documentation Generator for Django REST Framework: deprecated
repos.summary_zh: Django REST Swagger 是一个为 Django REST Framework 提供 Swagger 文档生成的工具，现已废弃。它通过 OpenAPIRenderer 和 SwaggerUIRenderer 自动生成 API 的 OpenAPI 规范及交互式文档界面，支持自定义标题和路由配置，适用于快速构建可浏览的 REST API 文档。
repos.summary_en: Django REST Swagger was a deprecated tool for generating Swagger documentation for Django REST Framework. It provided OpenAPIRenderer and SwaggerUIRenderer to auto-generate API specs and interactive UI, enabling browsable REST API docs with customizable titles and routing, now succeeded by drf-yasg.

repos.description: Material Design for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Material 是一个为 Django 框架打造的 Material Design 3 组件库，提供完整的 CRUD 和管理界面。它基于 TailwindCSS 和 django-cotton，无需构建步骤即可使用预编译的 CSS/JS，支持响应式、无障碍访问及 SPA 式导航，专为 AI 辅助开发优化，实现快速、现代化的 Django 前端开发。
repos.summary_en: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

repos.description: Browser-native Office / PDF / CAD / archive viewer for internal web apps, with Vue, React, Svelte, jQuery, Web Components, and no server-side conversion.
repos.summary_zh: Flyfish File Viewer 是一款纯前端文件预览组件，支持 Office、PDF、CAD、压缩包等 208 种格式。它利用浏览器原生解析与渲染技术，无需后端转换，确保数据隐私与安全。支持 Vue、React 等主流框架，具备按需加载和私有化部署能力，适用于企业内部系统。
repos.summary_en: Flyfish File Viewer is a browser-native file preview component supporting 208 formats including Office, PDF, CAD, and archives. It leverages client-side parsing and rendering without server-side conversion, ensuring data privacy. Compatible with Vue, React, and other frameworks, it offers lazy loading and private deployment for enterprise internal systems.

repos.description: Clamps an HTML element by adding ellipsis to it if the content inside is too long.
repos.summary_zh: Clamp.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于在 HTML 元素内容过长时自动截断并添加省略号。支持单行、多行及基于高度的自适应截断，提供灵活的字符分割策略和原生 WebKit 支持，适用于响应式文本展示场景。
repos.summary_en: Clamp.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that truncates HTML element content with ellipsis when text overflows. It supports single/multi-line clamping, auto-sizing based on height, customizable truncation characters, and optional native WebKit -webkit-line-clamp support, ideal for responsive text display.

repos.description: Modern theme for Django admin interface
repos.summary_zh: Django Suit 是一个现代化的 Django 管理后台主题，提供简洁美观的界面设计，显著提升 Django 管理员的使用体验。支持 v1 稳定版与 v2 开发版，具备响应式布局和增强的交互功能，适用于需要优化后台管理界面的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: Django Suit is a modern theme for the Django admin interface, offering a clean and enhanced UI to improve the admin experience. It supports both stable v1 and experimental v2 versions, featuring responsive design and improved usability for Django projects requiring a professional admin panel.

repos.description: Django friendly finite state machine support
repos.summary_zh: Django-fsm 是一个为 Django 设计的有限状态机支持库，用于以声明式方式管理对象的状态与状态转换规则。它通过 Python 枚举定义状态，提供装饰器方式声明合法转换路径，防止非法状态变更，适用于构建持久化工作流系统。自 2024 年发布 3.0 版本后更名为 viewflow.fsm，API 重构更现代化，支持快速搭建带 UI 的工作流应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-fsm is a finite state machine library designed for Django, enabling declarative management of object states and transitions. It uses Python enums to define states and decorators to enforce valid state changes, preventing unauthorized transitions. Ideal for building persistent workflow systems with minimal setup. Renamed to viewflow.fsm in its 3.0 release (2024), it features a modernized API better suited for current development needs.

repos.description: Django friendly finite state machine support
repos.summary_zh: viewflow.fsm 是专为 Django 设计的有限状态机（FSM）支持库，提供声明式工作流建模能力。通过 Python 枚举和 Django 枚举类型定义状态与转换规则，确保状态变更的严格控制和数据库无关性，适用于构建持久化业务流程与自动化工作流系统。
repos.summary_en: viewflow.fsm is a Django-friendly finite state machine library enabling declarative workflow modeling. It uses Python enums and Django enumeration types to define states and transitions, enforcing strict state control and database independence for building persistent business processes and automated workflows.

repos.description: Bootstrap 3 integration with Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-bootstrap3 是 Bootstrap 3 与 Django 的无缝集成库，提供简洁的模板标签（如 `bootstrap_form`）快速渲染响应式表单。现已进入维护模式，仅修复漏洞，建议新项目使用 Bootstrap 5 及对应包 django-bootstrap5。
repos.summary_en: django-bootstrap3 integrates Bootstrap 3 with Django via easy-to-use template tags like `bootstrap_form` for rapid responsive form rendering. Now in maintenance mode—only security fixes—with recommended migration to django-bootstrap5 for new projects.

repos.description: A lightweight, scalable, mobile-first CSS framework
repos.summary_zh: Mobi.css 是一个轻量级、可扩展、移动优先的 CSS 框架，默认包仅 3kb（gzip 后），提供基础样式以构建简洁优雅的网页。其插件系统支持模块化扩展，可独立使用插件，专为移动端优化，同时兼容桌面端，适合内容丰富的页面。
repos.summary_en: Mobi.css is a lightweight, scalable, mobile-first CSS framework. With a default bundle of only 3kb (gzipped), it provides essential styles for clean and elegant webpages. Its plugin system enables modular scalability, allowing plugins to be used standalone or integrated, optimized for mobile but also excellent on desktop.

repos.description: Cross domain local storage, with permissions
repos.summary_zh: cross-storage 是一个跨域本地存储解决方案，通过权限控制实现多浏览器窗口/标签页安全共享 localStorage。采用 Hub-Client 架构，支持 ES6 Promise API，突破同源限制，允许不同域名间共享最多 2.49MB 数据，适用于单点登录、多页面状态同步等场景。
repos.summary_en: Cross-storage enables secure cross-domain localStorage sharing via a permission-controlled Hub-Client architecture. Using iframes and postMessage, it allows multiple browser tabs/windows from different domains to share a single storage space with up to 2.49MB capacity, featuring ES6 Promise-based API for seamless integration.

repos.description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
repos.summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

repos.description: A web developer workflow used by WeChat team based on Gulp, with cross-platform supported and solutions prepared.
repos.summary_zh: Tencent tmt-workflow 是基于 Gulp 的前端自动化开发工作流工具，专为微信团队设计，支持跨平台（macOS & Windows）。提供 Less/Sass 编译、CSS 雪碧图、图片压缩、SVG 内联、JS 合并、LiveReload 实时刷新、FTP 部署等完整解决方案，集成 px2rem、WebP 适配等现代前端优化方案，现已迁移至 Feflow 项目。
repos.summary_en: Tencent's tmt-workflow is a Gulp-based frontend development workflow tool designed for the WeChat team, offering cross-platform support (macOS & Windows). It provides comprehensive automation features including Less/Sass compilation, CSS sprites, image compression, SVG inlining, JS bundling, LiveReload, and FTP deployment. Integrated solutions for px2rem, WebP, and MD5 reversion are included. The project has been migrated to Feflow.

repos.description: Beautiful  UI components build with vue and ant design
repos.summary_zh: vue-beauty 是一个基于 Vue 和 Ant Design 构建的精美 UI 组件库，提供丰富的常用场景组件，采用组件化开发模式，封装复杂逻辑并提供简洁 API，内置样式优化与 ES 新特性垫片，支持现代浏览器，助力开发者快速构建美观的 Vue 应用。
repos.summary_en: vue-beauty is a beautiful UI component library built with Vue and Ant Design, offering a rich set of components for common scenarios. It follows Vue's component-driven architecture, encapsulates complexity with simple APIs, includes optimized Ant Design styling and ES polyfills, and supports modern browsers to accelerate Vue app development.

repos.description: Awesome Django authorization, without the database
repos.summary_zh: django-rules 是一个轻量级但功能强大的 Django 权限管理库，无需数据库即可实现对象级权限控制。它基于规则系统构建，支持复杂谓词组合、动态权限判断，并深度集成 Django 视图、模板和 Admin，提供高效、灵活的授权解决方案。
repos.summary_en: django-rules is a lightweight yet powerful Django authorization library enabling object-level permissions without requiring a database. Built on a rule-based system, it supports complex predicate logic, dynamic permissions, and seamless integration with Django views, templates, and Admin for efficient access control.

repos.description: A clock-style timepicker for Bootstrap (or jQuery). Sorry but no longer maintained.
repos.summary_zh: ClockPicker 是一个基于 Bootstrap 或 jQuery 的类时钟风格时间选择器，提供直观的时钟界面用于时间输入。支持桌面和移动设备，兼容 IE9+，具备自动关闭、12/24小时制切换、回调函数等丰富功能，适用于需要美观时间选择器的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: ClockPicker is a clock-style timepicker built for Bootstrap or jQuery, offering an intuitive analog clock interface for time selection. It supports major browsers including IE9+, works on both desktop and mobile devices, and provides features like autoclose, 12/24-hour modes, and customizable callbacks for enhanced user experience.

repos.description: A collapsible jQuery menu plugin
repos.summary_zh: metismenu 是一个轻量级 jQuery 插件，用于创建可折叠的侧边栏菜单。支持现代浏览器，提供流畅的展开/折叠动画，具备 ARIA 可访问性支持，可通过 CSS 类（如 has-arrow）自定义箭头样式，适用于后台管理系统等需要多级导航的场景。
repos.summary_en: MetisMenu is a lightweight jQuery plugin for creating collapsible sidebar menus. It supports modern browsers only, offers smooth expand/collapse animations, includes ARIA accessibility features, and allows customization via CSS classes like has-arrow, making it ideal for admin dashboards and multi-level navigation systems.

repos.description: GitHub notifications alike app for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-notifications 是一个专为 Django 设计的 GitHub 风格通知系统，基于 Activity Streams 规范构建。它通过 Actor、Verb、Action Object 和 Target 四元组模型实现灵活的事件通知机制，支持任意 Django 对象间的关联，适用于构建用户动态、活动提醒等场景。
repos.summary_en: django-notifications is a GitHub-style notification system for Django, built on the Activity Streams specification. It uses a four-component model (Actor, Verb, Action Object, Target) to create flexible event-based notifications, supporting arbitrary Django object relationships for user activity feeds and real-time alerts.

repos.description: [废弃] {官方中文马上就来了} GitHub 汉化插件，GitHub 中文化界面。 (GitHub Translation To Chinese)
repos.summary_zh: GitHub 汉化插件为英文基础薄弱用户提供中文界面支持，通过 Tampermonkey 实现 GitHub 全站翻译，帮助新手快速上手。插件每日自动更新翻译内容，支持 Chrome、Opera 等主流浏览器，并提供手动安装指南。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Hans is a Tampermonkey-based plugin that translates GitHub's full interface into Chinese, aiding users with limited English proficiency. It auto-updates translations daily and supports major browsers like Chrome and Opera, with clear installation instructions.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: File and Image Management Application for django
repos.summary_zh: django-filer 是专为 Django 设计的文件与图片管理应用，提供直观的文件库管理、图片裁剪、批量操作等功能，深度集成 django CMS，支持拖拽上传、权限控制和多格式预览，显著提升内容管理系统的媒体资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Django Filer is a file and image management application for Django that simplifies handling of media assets. It offers intuitive file browsing, image manipulation, batch operations, and seamless integration with django CMS, enhancing content management workflows with drag-and-drop uploads, permission controls, and multi-format support.

repos.description: An issue tracking tool based on laravel+reactjs for small and medium-sized enterprises, open-source and free, similar to Jira.
repos.summary_zh: ActionView 是一款基于 Laravel+React 的开源问题跟踪工具，专为中小型企业设计，功能类似 Jira。支持敏捷看板、甘特图、自定义工作流、权限管理、LDAP 集成、GitLab/GitHub Webhook 联动等，提供清晰代码结构和 Docker 部署方案，适用于轻量级项目管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: ActionView is an open-source issue tracking tool built with Laravel (backend) and React+Redux (frontend), targeting SMEs as a Jira alternative. It supports agile boards, Gantt charts, custom workflows, LDAP integration, GitLab/GitHub webhooks, and Docker deployment, offering clean code and extensibility for team collaboration.

repos.description: HTML to PDF in the browser — one line of code for selectable, searchable vector PDFs (10,000+ pages). Pure frontend: zero backend, zero runtime deps. TypeScript over a Rust + WebAssembly engine; an html2canvas/jsPDF alternative.
repos.summary_zh: dompdf.js 是一个前端库，可将 HTML 转换为多页矢量 PDF，支持分页和数千页文档生成。基于 html2canvas 和 jspdf 改造，直接在浏览器中生成可编辑、非图像式的 PDF，具备高质量输出、小文件体积、无需服务端渲染等优势，适用于网页内容导出和打印场景。
repos.summary_en: dompdf.js is a frontend library that converts HTML into multi-thousand-page vector PDFs with a single line of code. Built on html2canvas and jspdf, it generates editable, non-image PDFs directly in the browser, offering high quality, small file size, and no server-side rendering. Ideal for web content export and printing.

repos.description: Animated border beam effect for React
