repos.summary_zh: border-beam 是一个轻量级 React 组件，为卡片、按钮等元素提供动态流光边框动画效果。支持多种尺寸预设、颜色主题（彩虹/单色/海洋/日落）和强度调节，可自动适配明暗背景。通过 CSS @property 实现高性能 GPU 加速动画，不影响内容交互。
repos.summary_en: border-beam is a lightweight React component that adds animated glowing border effects to any element. It supports multiple size presets, color variants (rainbow/mono/ocean/sunset), and intensity controls. Automatically adapts to dark/light themes with GPU-accelerated animations using CSS @property, ensuring smooth performance without interfering with content interaction.

repos.description: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme
repos.summary_zh: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme 是一款基于 Flat-UI 设计风格的移动端主题，提供现代化扁平化界面，支持 jQuery Mobile 1.3.0 至 1.4 版本，通过 Stylus 和 Grunt 实现自定义配色与样式扩展，适用于快速构建美观的移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme is a modern, flat design theme for jQuery Mobile inspired by Flat-UI. It supports versions 1.3.0 to 1.4, allows custom swatches via Stylus and Grunt, and enables rapid development of visually appealing mobile web applications.

repos.description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
repos.summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
repos.summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

repos.description: Responsive Image Maps jQuery Plugin
repos.summary_zh: jQuery RWD Image Maps 是一个响应式图像地图插件，通过动态重计算坐标，使 HTML 图像映射在窗口缩放或图像尺寸变化时保持精准定位，适用于响应式网页设计中的交互式图像区域。
repos.summary_en: jQuery RWD Image Maps is a responsive image maps plugin that recalculates area coordinates dynamically to maintain accurate clickable regions when images resize, ideal for interactive responsive web designs using HTML image maps.

repos.description: Old Celery integration project for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-celery 是 Celery 与 Django 的集成项目，专为 Celery v3.x 至 v4.x 设计，提供基于 Django ORM 和缓存的结果存储、任务模块自动发现及后台管理功能。现已停止维护，推荐使用新版 Celery 教程替代。
repos.summary_en: django-celery is a legacy integration project for Celery with Django, supporting Celery v3.x to v4.x only. It enables Django ORM-based result storage, automatic task discovery, and admin integration. The project is no longer actively maintained; users are advised to follow the updated Celery Django tutorial.

repos.description: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF-extensions 是 Django REST Framework 的扩展集合，提供 DetailSerializerMixin、缓存、条件请求、嵌套路由和批量操作等核心功能，支持多版本 Django 和 DRF，文档完善，适合企业级 API 开发。
repos.summary_en: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework, offering features like DetailSerializerMixin, caching, conditional requests, nested routes, and bulk operations. It supports multiple Django and DRF versions with comprehensive documentation, ideal for enterprise-grade API development.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: A beautiful component library based on vue3
repos.summary_zh: Lew UI 是一个基于 Vue3 的美观组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和开箱即用的样式。它集成了 Tippy.js、Lucide 图标、VueUse 等优质开源库，支持虚拟列表、表单验证等高级功能，文档完善，易于集成，适合快速构建现代化 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Lew UI is a beautiful Vue3-based component library offering a rich set of UI components with out-of-the-box styling. It integrates high-quality open-source libraries like Tippy.js, Lucide icons, and VueUse, supporting advanced features such as virtual lists and form validation. With comprehensive documentation and easy integration, it's ideal for rapidly building modern web applications.

repos.description: Django-ERP是一款基于Django开发的ERP管理软件，包含常用的销售管理、采购管理、库存管理、组织管理等，支持按项目归集费用，支持工作流审批，支持采购单、报价单的批量导入。
repos.summary_zh: Django-ERP是基于Django框架开发的开源企业资源管理系统，涵盖销售、采购、库存及组织管理模块，支持项目费用归集、工作流审批及单据批量导入，适用于中小企业内部管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Django-ERP is an open-source ERP management system built on Django, featuring modules for sales, procurement, inventory, and organizational management. It supports project-based cost allocation, workflow approvals, and bulk import of purchase orders and quotations, ideal for SMEs seeking streamlined internal operations.

repos.description: Dujiao-Next
repos.summary_zh: Dujiao-Next 是一款数字商品电商系统，包含 Go 后端、Vue 3 用户前台与管理后台。采用模块化单体架构，支持 JWT/Casbin RBAC/TOTP 双因素认证，集成 Redis 异步任务，适用于虚拟商品、AI 服务与数字礼品卡等电商场景。
repos.summary_en: Dujiao-Next is a digital goods e-commerce platform featuring a Go backend, Vue 3 storefront, and admin panel. It uses modular monolith architecture with JWT, Casbin RBAC, and TOTP 2FA, plus Redis-based async jobs via asynq — ideal for virtual products, AI services, and digital gift cards.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: A Django app that keeps a log of changes made to an object.
repos.summary_zh: django-auditlog 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于自动记录模型对象的所有变更，包括操作用户、变更摘要及详细 JSON 数据，支持灵活查询与审计追踪，适用于需要完整操作日志的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-auditlog is a lightweight Django app that automatically logs all changes to model objects, capturing the actor, change summary, and detailed JSON data for flexible auditing and traceability.

repos.description: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

repos.description: A JQuery validation framework for bootstrap forms.
repos.summary_zh: jqBootstrapValidation 是一个专为 Bootstrap 表单设计的 jQuery 验证框架，支持实时输入验证并在 help-block 元素中显示错误提示，提升表单交互体验。
repos.summary_en: jqBootstrapValidation is a jQuery validation framework designed for Bootstrap forms, providing real-time input validation and displaying error messages in help-block elements to enhance form user experience.

repos.description: Tiny JS library using bootstrap's popovers to help guide your users around your website
repos.summary_zh: Bootstro.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，利用 Bootstrap 的弹出框（popover）功能，为网站提供用户引导功能。支持 Bootstrap 2 和 3，无需修改代码即可适配，仅需一行变更即可从 Bootstrap 2 升级。支持通过 JS 变量或 AJAX 动态加载引导数据，避免污染 HTML，提升可维护性。
repos.summary_en: Bootstro.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that leverages Bootstrap's popover functionality to guide users through a website. It supports both Bootstrap 2 and 3 with minimal code changes. It enables dynamic slideshow creation via JavaScript variables or AJAX, avoiding HTML pollution and improving maintainability.

repos.description: Simple prebuilt applications.
repos.summary_zh: Django Basic Apps 是一组预构建的 Django 应用集合，提供博客、媒体内嵌等基础功能模块。支持通过模板标记语法 `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` 实现内容内嵌，需依赖 Django Comments、Tagging、Markdown 等第三方库。
repos.summary_en: Django Basic Apps is a collection of prebuilt Django applications offering core features like blogging and content inlining. It supports embedding objects via template markup `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` and requires dependencies such as Django Comments, Tagging, and Markdown libraries.

repos.description: WebSockets for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

repos.description: Hexo theme, Blog theme, Clean, Responsive theme
repos.summary_zh: Hexo主题diaspora是一款简洁清新的响应式博客主题，支持Ajax加载、音乐播放、分类标签页和本地搜索功能，适合摄影、影评、乐评等文艺类博客，提供丰富的自定义配置选项。
repos.summary_en: Hexo-theme-diaspora is a clean, responsive blog theme featuring Ajax loading, music playback, category/tag pages, and local search. Ideal for photography, film, and music reviews, it offers extensive customization via configuration options.

repos.description: A drop-in replacement for Django's runserver.
repos.summary_zh: django-devserver 是 Django runserver 的即用型替代方案，提供实时 SQL 日志、Werkzeug 调试器集成、多进程/线程支持及内存分析等功能，显著提升开发调试效率。
repos.summary_en: django-devserver is a drop-in replacement for Django's runserver, offering real-time SQL logging, Werkzeug debugger integration, multi-process/threaded modes, and memory profiling to enhance development debugging.

repos.description: Accounts for Django made beautifully simple
repos.summary_zh: Django Userena 是一个为 Django 项目提供完整账户管理的开源应用，涵盖用户注册、激活、消息通知等功能，采用 BSD 许可可免费商用。其核心优势在于高度可定制性与开箱即用的用户体验，显著简化 Django 用户认证系统的开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Django Userena is an open-source Django application that provides complete account management including signup, activation, and messaging. It features full customization, BSD licensing for free commercial use, and streamlines user authentication development with a polished, production-ready interface.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: Material Design 中文版 ( 2015 年 8 月更新)
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文版是 Google 官方设计规范的首个完整中文翻译项目，由 1sters 团队联合极客学院于 2015 年 8 月完成全面更新。该项目系统性地将 Material Design 核心理念、组件规范与交互原则转化为高质量中文文档，覆盖 60+ 章节，极大推动了中国开发者对现代移动 UI 设计的理解与实践。
repos.summary_en: Material Design 中文版 is the first complete Chinese translation of Google's official design specification, collaboratively completed by the 1sters team and Geekbang Academy in August 2015. This project systematically translates core concepts, component specifications, and interaction principles of Material Design into high-quality documentation, covering over 60 chapters, significantly advancing the understanding and practice of modern mobile UI design among Chinese developers.

repos.description: Cache-based rate-limiting for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Ratelimit 是一个基于缓存的 Django 速率限制中间件，通过装饰器为视图提供灵活的限流功能，支持基于 IP 地址或请求参数（GET/POST）进行访问控制，适用于防止滥用和保障 API 安全。
repos.summary_en: Django Ratelimit is a cache-based rate-limiting library for Django that uses decorators to limit view access, configurable by IP address or request parameters (GET/POST), ideal for preventing abuse and securing APIs.

repos.description: Hand-drawn CSS annotations for inline content
repos.summary_zh: neat-annotations 是一个纯 CSS 库，用于在网页内联内容上添加手绘风格的箭头和手写标签。无需 JavaScript 和构建步骤，仅通过一个自包含的 CSS 文件即可实现。支持 8 个方向、6 种内置配色及自定义颜色，并提供丰富的 CSS 变量进行微调，适合用于文档说明、教程演示或 UI 原型标注。
repos.summary_en: neat-annotations is a pure CSS library for adding hand-drawn arrows and handwritten labels to inline web content. It requires no JavaScript or build steps, operating via a single self-contained CSS file. Featuring 8 directions, 6 built-in color themes, custom color support, and extensive CSS variable fine-tuning, it is ideal for documentation, tutorials, and UI prototyping annotations.

repos.description: vue2.0-tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource. It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

repos.description: css files created from pygment's built-in styles
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供由 Pygments 内置样式生成的预编译 CSS 文件，用于代码高亮显示，避免用户手动生成。支持一键重新生成所有样式文件，简化了代码语法高亮在网页中的集成流程。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides pre-generated CSS files from Pygments' built-in styles for code syntax highlighting, eliminating the need for manual generation. It allows easy regeneration of all styles using the current Pygments version via a simple make command.

repos.description: :no_entry: currently unmaintained :no_entry: A minimal JS library for showing & hiding things
repos.summary_zh: Wallop 是一个轻量级（4KB）JavaScript 库，用于实现元素的显示与隐藏切换，支持移动端优先、渐进增强和纯 CSS 动画。它通过添加动态类名控制内容展示，内置多种动画修饰符（如滑动、淡入淡出），提供灵活的 API 和自定义事件，适用于轮播、选项卡等场景。
repos.summary_en: Wallop is a minimal 4kb JavaScript library for showing and hiding elements, designed with mobile-first, progressive enhancement, and CSS-based animations. It dynamically adds classes to control visibility, supports multiple animation modifiers (e.g., slide, fade), and offers a flexible API with custom events for use in sliders, tabs, and more.

repos.description: A simple yet powerful JQuery star rating plugin with fractional rating support.
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap-star-rating 是一款基于 jQuery 的 Bootstrap 星级评分插件，支持分数评级、RTL 方向及纯 CSS3 矢量图标渲染。它可自动将输入框转换为评分控件，兼容 Bootstrap 3/4/5，并支持 FontAwesome 等字体图标库，适用于需要灵活星级评分功能的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap-star-rating is a jQuery plugin for Bootstrap that enables star rating controls with fractional support, RTL compatibility, and pure CSS3 styling. It auto-converts inputs marked with class 'rating', supports Bootstrap 3/4/5, and integrates with font icon libraries like FontAwesome for scalable vector star symbols.

repos.description: Twitter Bootstrap with Metro style
repos.summary_zh: metro-bootstrap 是基于 Twitter Bootstrap 的 Metro 风格主题，提供现代化的扁平化界面设计，支持通过 npm、Git 或 CDN 快速集成，包含预编译 CSS 和 FontAwesome 字体，适用于快速构建 Windows Metro 风格网页应用。
repos.summary_en: metro-bootstrap is a Metro-styled theme built on Twitter Bootstrap, offering a modern flat UI design. It supports easy integration via npm, Git clone, or CDN, includes precompiled CSS and FontAwesome fonts, ideal for quickly building Windows Metro-style web applications.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills 是基于 opencli 框架的 Claude Code 技能集合，支持79+网站和桌面应用的CLI化操作，涵盖B站、Twitter、知乎等主流平台的内容获取、发布、下载及浏览器自动化功能，具备智能搜索路由和适配器自动修复能力。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills is a collection of Claude Code skills built on the opencli framework, enabling CLI operations for 79+ websites and desktop apps. It supports content retrieval, publishing, downloading, and browser automation across platforms like Bilibili, Twitter, Zhihu, with intelligent search routing and auto-repair capabilities.

repos.description: A verified, community-maintained catalog of 981 open-source projects built with Jev.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Jev 是社区维护的开源项目目录，收录 640 个基于 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的类型决策模型）构建的项目，涵盖 SDK、AI 智能体工具、浏览器自动化、游戏模拟等 11 个类别。每个条目均标注具体决策点及可验证的公开证据，帮助开发者快速发现并评估真实参考实现。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Jev is a community-maintained catalog of 640 open-source projects built with Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions in software. Spanning 11 categories across SDKs, agent tooling, browser automation, games, and more, each entry identifies concrete decision points and links to verifiable public evidence for evaluating real implementations.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图海报生成工具，可将任意城市地图转化为精美的艺术海报。作为 Python CLI 工具的 Web 升级版，它无需安装，开箱即用。项目采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端，利用 Rust 编译为 WebAssembly 实现高性能图像处理，结合 Tailwind CSS 打造现代化 UI，支持全球主要城市的地图风格化设计。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map poster generator that transforms city maps into stunning artistic designs. As a web upgrade to the Python CLI tool, it requires no installation and is ready to use instantly. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust compiled to WebAssembly for high-performance image processing, paired with Tailwind CSS for a modern UI, supporting stylized map designs for major global cities.

repos.description: A Gorgeous LoadingView (一个绚丽的LoadingView )
repos.summary_zh: GADownloading 是一个绚丽的自定义 Android LoadingView，无需图片资源，通过代码实现动态加载动画。支持成功/失败状态切换，提供丰富的自定义属性（颜色、线条、文本等），可自动调整尺寸。适用于下载进度展示，兼容 JitPack 集成与源码复制两种接入方式，强调纯代码实现与高度可定制性。
repos.summary_en: GADownloading is a visually stunning custom Android LoadingView that renders animations purely through code without image resources. It supports dynamic progress updates, success/failure states, and extensive customization via XML attributes. Designed for download progress indication, it offers JitPack integration or direct source copying, emphasizing code-only implementation and high configurability.

repos.description: ajax + history.pushState = pjax
repos.summary_zh: Pjax 是一个基于 pushState 和 AJAX 的前端技术，用于实现无刷新页面内容更新，支持 jQuery、qwrap 和 KISSY 框架。它提供缓存、本地存储、动画过渡及自定义过滤功能，适用于提升单页应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Pjax is a frontend technology combining AJAX and pushState to enable seamless, partial page updates without full reloads. It supports jQuery, qwrap, and KISSY, with features like caching, localStorage persistence, animation transitions, and URL filtering for enhanced SPA performance.

repos.description: 个人博客
repos.summary_zh: 个人技术博客，涵盖算法、数据结构、计算机基础、分布式系统等核心领域，包含MIT 6.824课程笔记、Go/PHP语言实践、Pulsar消息队列及自研库设计文档，是系统性技术知识沉淀平台。
repos.summary_en: Personal technical blog covering core computer science topics including algorithms, data structures, distributed systems (MIT 6.824 course notes), Go/PHP programming, Pulsar MQ, and custom library design docs, serving as a comprehensive knowledge repository.

repos.description: 此项目已停止维护，建议迁移到  https://github.com/museui/muse-ui/
repos.summary_zh: vue-carbon 是基于 Vue.js 1.0 开发的 Material Design 风格移动端 Web UI 库，提供丰富的组件如 Refresh Control、HeaderBar 等，支持 npm 安装与 webpack 集成，现已停止维护，推荐迁移至 Muse UI。
repos.summary_en: Vue-carbon is a Material Design style mobile web UI library built with Vue.js 1.0, featuring components like Refresh Control and HeaderBar. It supports npm installation and webpack integration but is no longer maintained; migration to Muse UI is recommended.

repos.description: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

repos.description: dead simple crontab powered job scheduling for django.
repos.summary_zh: django-crontab 是一个为 Django 项目提供极简 Cron 任务调度的工具，支持通过 Python 方法或 Django 管理命令定义定时任务，自动同步到系统 crontab，并提供添加、查看和移除任务的管理命令，适用于 1.8-2.0 版本的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-crontab is a dead-simple tool for Django that enables cron-powered job scheduling via Python methods or management commands. It automatically syncs CRONJOBS to the system crontab and provides commands to add, show, and remove tasks, supporting Django 1.8-2.0.

repos.description: Bootstrap alert system made better, builds off of bootstrap-alert.js
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap-notify 是对 Bootstrap 原生警告系统的增强扩展，基于 bootstrap-alert.js 构建，提供更丰富的通知样式与交互能力，适用于现代 Web 应用中的用户提示与消息展示。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Notify enhances the native Bootstrap alert system by building on bootstrap-alert.js, offering improved notification styles and interactions for modern web applications.

repos.description: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
repos.summary_zh: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
repos.summary_en: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: opencli-skill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，通过复用 Chrome 登录态直接操控 B站、知乎、Twitter/X、YouTube 等 16 大平台，支持内容浏览、搜索与发布，无需 API Key，实现自然语言驱动的跨平台自动化交互。
repos.summary_en: opencli-skill is a Claude Code skill that enables natural language control over 16 major platforms (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube) by reusing your Chrome login sessions via opencli CLI—no API keys required—supporting reading, searching, and posting across social and content sites.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.description: a library for adding declarative ajax functionality to your website
repos.summary_zh: eldarion-ajax 是一个用于为网站添加声明式 AJAX 功能的 JavaScript 库，通过 jQuery 实现。它简化了重复的 AJAX 代码编写，支持通过服务器返回的 JSON 中 `html` 字段渲染 HTML 片段，无需前端模板引擎。支持 `<a>` 点击、表单提交等常见交互，适用于现代 Web 应用的无刷新操作场景。
repos.summary_en: eldarion-ajax is a JavaScript library that enables declarative AJAX functionality on websites using jQuery. It eliminates repetitive $.ajax code by leveraging server-rendered HTML fragments returned in JSON. Designed for seamless integration with server-side templates, it supports common actions like link clicks and form submissions without full page reloads.

repos.description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
repos.summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
repos.summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

repos.description: A SSL-enabled development server for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-sslserver 是一个为 Django 框架提供 SSL 支持的本地开发服务器，支持自签名证书和自定义 CA 证书，适用于开发环境 HTTPS 调试，但不建议用于生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Django SSL Server is a development-only SSL-enabled server for Django, supporting self-signed and CA-trusted certificates, ideal for local HTTPS testing during development, though not recommended for production use.

repos.description: AI generate code
repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: [UNMAINTAINED] Online reStructuredText editor
repos.summary_zh: rsted 是一个基于 Flask 的在线 reStructuredText 编辑器，提供实时预览功能，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。虽然项目已停止维护，但可作为轻量级 RST 文档编辑工具使用，适合快速编写和预览技术文档。
repos.summary_en: rsted is a simple online reStructuredText editor built with Flask, offering real-time preview. Though unmaintained, it provides a lightweight solution for editing and previewing RST documents, deployable via Docker or local server on port 5000.

repos.description: A customizable plug-in photo gallery management application for the Django web framework.
repos.summary_zh: Django-photologue 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的强大图片管理与画廊应用，支持上传照片、创建画廊、添加水印等效果，提供灵活的插件化架构，适用于构建定制化图片展示网站。
repos.summary_en: Django-photologue is a powerful image management and gallery application for Django, enabling photo uploads, gallery organization, watermarking, and flexible customization for web-based photo displays.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

repos.description: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
repos.summary_zh: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
repos.summary_en: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.

repos.description: A Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG and SVG output — no browser, no Chromium, no DOM.
repos.summary_zh: marknative 是一个原生 Markdown 渲染引擎，无需浏览器或 DOM，直接生成分页的 PNG/SVG 文档。它通过自建排版引擎实现确定性分页和头less服务端渲染，支持 CommonMark + GFM 语法，适用于 API 文档、电子书等需要精确控制排版的场景。
repos.summary_en: marknative is a native Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG/SVG output without requiring a browser, Chromium, or DOM. It parses Markdown into an internal document model, runs its own layout and pagination engine, and paints pages using Skia Canvas. Ideal for deterministic, server-side rendering of technical docs, e-books, and reports.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: 网站
repos.summary_zh: 开源阅读官网基于 Docusaurus 2 构建，提供文档、博客和下载功能，支持 Markdown 内容创作，便于用户贡献阅读APP相关资源，提升社区知识共享效率。
repos.summary_en: The open-source reading official website is built with Docusaurus 2, featuring documentation, blogs, and downloads. It supports Markdown-based content contributions for the reading app, enhancing community knowledge sharing.

repos.description: django-threadedcomments is a simple yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-threadedcomments 是一个基于 Django 的简洁灵活线程化评论系统，支持评论嵌套回复。它构建于 django_comments 之上，易于扩展，提供完整的模板标签和表单渲染功能，适用于博客、文章等内容的互动评论场景。
repos.summary_en: django-threadedcomments is a lightweight yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django, enabling nested replies to both posts and other comments. Built on django_comments, it offers extensible template tags and seamless integration with custom designs, ideal for blogs and articles.

repos.description: cxSelect 是基于 jQuery 的多级联动菜单插件，适用于省市、商品分类等联动菜单。
repos.summary_zh: cxSelect 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Zepto 的多级联动菜单插件，支持通过 AJAX 或自定义 JSON 数据动态加载省市、商品分类等层级选项，兼容移动端，提供灵活的参数配置与 API 控制，适用于表单联动场景。
repos.summary_en: cxSelect is a jQuery and Zepto-based plugin for multi-level cascading menus, supporting dynamic loading of hierarchical options (e.g., provinces, cities) via AJAX or custom JSON data. It offers flexible configuration, mobile compatibility, and full API control for form interactions.

repos.description: A minimal django project containing a minimal app with a working jquery file upload form based on the work by Sebastian Tschan: http://aquantum-demo.appspot.com/file-upload
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Sebastian Tschan 的 jQuery-File-Upload 组件的极简 Django 文件上传示例，支持拖拽上传、多文件选择、上传取消及文件删除功能，无需 Flash 等浏览器插件，适用于快速集成前端文件上传到 Django 后端。
repos.summary_en: This is a minimal Django project demonstrating how to integrate Sebastian Tschan's jQuery-File-Upload component, featuring drag-and-drop, multi-file selection, upload cancellation, and file deletion. It requires no browser plugins like Flash and is ideal for quickly adding robust file upload functionality to Django applications.

repos.description: Detect mobile browsers and serve different template flavours to them.
repos.summary_zh: django-mobile 是一个 Django 中间件工具，用于自动检测移动端浏览器并动态切换模板渲染。它通过中间件识别用户设备类型，并基于预设的 'flavour'（如 mobile/desktop）透明加载对应模板（如 mobile/index.html），支持多设备适配和优雅降级，无需修改视图逻辑即可实现响应式站点。
repos.summary_en: django-mobile is a Django middleware that detects mobile browsers and serves different templates accordingly. It uses middleware to identify device type, then transparently loads flavored templates (e.g., mobile/index.html) based on the detected 'flavour', enabling responsive design without altering view logic. It supports multiple mobile flavors and graceful fallback to default templates.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: Bootstrap-themed jquery tag interface
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tags 是一个 jQuery 插件，用于扩展 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签功能，支持 Bootstrap 2.3.2 和 3+ 版本。它提供自动建议、排除/过滤列表、占位符提示、Bootstrap 按钮样式集成以及可自定义的扩展点，适用于需要交互式标签输入的 Web 表单场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tags is a jQuery plugin that extends Twitter Bootstrap with tagging functionality, supporting Bootstrap 2.3.2 and 3+. It features autosuggest, exclusion/filtering, popovers, placeholder prompts, and Bootstrap button styling, making it ideal for interactive tag-based input in web forms.

repos.description: A set of utilities for creating robust pagination tools throughout a django application.
repos.summary_zh: django-pagination 提供了一套用于在 Django 应用中构建健壮分页工具的实用程序，现已停止维护。其维护分支可在 pydanny/dj-pagination 获取，适用于需要高效处理大量数据展示的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-pagination offers utilities for building robust pagination tools in Django applications. This project is no longer maintained; a supported fork is available at pydanny/dj-pagination, ideal for web apps requiring efficient data pagination.

repos.description: Scrapy extension to write scraped items using Django models
repos.summary_zh: scrapy-djangoitem 是一个 Scrapy 扩展，允许使用 Django 模型定义 Scrapy 项目中的 Item。它提供 DjangoItem 类，将 Django 模型字段自动映射为 Scrapy Item 字段，并支持通过 save() 方法将抓取数据直接保存为 Django 模型实例，简化了爬虫与 Django 应用的数据集成。
repos.summary_en: scrapy-djangoitem is a Scrapy extension that enables defining Scrapy items using existing Django models. It provides the DjangoItem class, which automatically maps Django model fields to Scrapy item fields and supports saving scraped data directly into Django model instances via the save() method, streamlining integration between Scrapy crawlers and Django applications.

repos.description: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

repos.description: 🥘Base on element-ui, makes crud easily
repos.summary_zh: el-data-table 是基于 element-ui 封装的 CRUD 表格组件，支持自动请求、分页、树形数据、自定义搜索和操作列，集成 @femessage/el-form-renderer 渲染表单，通过配置化实现快速开发 RESTful API 管理界面。
repos.summary_en: el-data-table is a CRUD table component built on element-ui, featuring auto data fetching via axios, pagination, tree structures, custom search, and operation columns. It uses @femessage/el-form-renderer for form rendering and supports configuration-driven RESTful API management.

repos.description: 📁 轻盈优雅的 Web 原生 Cloudflare R2 桶文件管理器，一切皆在浏览器中完成。 | 📁 A lightweight, elegant, pure-browser Cloudflare R2 file manager. Everything happens right in your browser.
repos.summary_zh: R2 Web 是一款轻量级、优雅的纯浏览器 Cloudflare R2 文件管理器，无需构建或后端服务。它支持拖拽上传、图片压缩、多语言界面、深色模式及 PWA 桌面安装，所有操作均在客户端完成，直连 R2 API，保障数据安全。
repos.summary_en: R2 Web is a lightweight, elegant, pure-browser file manager for Cloudflare R2, with no build step or backend required. It supports drag-and-drop uploads, image compression, multi-language UI, dark mode, and PWA desktop installation—all client-side operations directly connecting to the R2 API.

repos.description: Simple and easy use python web framework
repos.summary_zh: Uliweb 是一个基于 Python 的全栈 Web 框架，核心设计目标是可重用性、可配置性和可替换性。采用 MVT 架构，支持模块化应用开发，集成 Werkzeug 路由、SQLAlchemy ORM 和 Alembic 数据库迁移，内置表单处理、国际化、缓存与会话管理，模板支持原生 Python 代码，提升开发效率与代码复用。
repos.summary_en: Uliweb is a full-stack Python web framework emphasizing reusability, configurability, and replaceability. It uses the MVT pattern, modular apps, Werkzeug routing, SQLAlchemy ORM with Alembic migrations, built-in form handling, i18n, caching, and session management. Templates support native Python code, enabling efficient and DRY development.

repos.description: DjangoUeditor
repos.summary_zh: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

repos.description: A Django address model and field. Addresses may be specified by address components or by performing an automatic Google Maps lookup.
repos.summary_zh: Django Address 是一个用于存储和管理邮政地址的 Django 模型库，支持通过 Google Maps API 自动解析地址或手动输入地址组件。它提供标准化的地址结构（国家、州、地区、街道），并包含一个便捷的 AddressField 字段类型，简化地址的创建、更新和查询操作，适用于需要精确地址管理的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django Address is a Django library providing models and fields for storing and retrieving postal addresses. It supports automatic address resolution via Google Maps API or manual input of address components, offering a standardized structure (country, state, locality, street) and an AddressField for easy integration into Django models, ideal for applications requiring precise address handling.

repos.description: 基于avalon的组件库
repos.summary_zh: avalon.oniui 是去哪儿网前端团队基于 Avalon 1.4 开发的 UI 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件（如表格、弹窗、分页）和功能性组件（如拖拽、定位、快捷键），覆盖表单、交互、数据展示等场景，支持模块化调用与扩展。
repos.summary_en: avalon.oniui is a UI component library developed by Qunar's frontend team, built on Avalon 1.4. It offers a comprehensive set of UI components (e.g., grids, dialogs, pagination) and utility modules (e.g., drag-and-drop, positioning, hotkeys), enabling modular integration for web applications with rich interactivity and data presentation.

repos.description: Native AngularJS colorpicker directive. No dependency on jQuery or jQuery plugin is required.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个原生 AngularJS 颜色选择器指令，基于 bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery 库开发，无需依赖 jQuery。支持 Hex、RGB、RGBA 格式，可自定义位置、尺寸和事件，适用于 Bootstrap v3.x.x 项目，提供灵活的配置选项和丰富的交互事件。
repos.summary_en: A native AngularJS color picker directive based on bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery library, with no jQuery dependency. Supports Hex, RGB, RGBA formats, customizable positioning, sizing, and events. Ideal for Bootstrap v3.x.x projects with flexible configuration and rich interaction events.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: Flux AI Image generator
repos.summary_zh: Next Money 是一个基于 Next.js 14 的全栈 SaaS 启动模板，集成 Stripe 支付、Clerk 认证、Supabase 数据库、React Email 和 Shadcn/ui 等现代技术栈，专为快速构建商业化 SaaS 产品而设计，提供完整的用户管理、支付处理与邮件通知解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Next Money is a full-stack SaaS starter template built with Next.js 14, integrating Stripe payments, Clerk authentication, Supabase database, React Email, and Shadcn/ui. It accelerates SaaS development with ready-to-use user management, payment processing, and email notification features.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

repos.description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
repos.summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

repos.description: TTS-文本转语音/文本转语音前端，兼容OpenAI、EdgeTTS等接口
repos.summary_zh: LibreTTS 是一款开源在线文本转语音工具，支持300+种语言和口音的声音，兼容OpenAI与EdgeTTS等主流TTS接口。提供实时试听、语速语调调节、长文本分段处理、历史记录及自定义API配置功能，支持Vercel和Cloudflare Pages一键部署，适合个人或企业快速搭建私有化TTS服务。
repos.summary_en: LibreTTS is an open-source online text-to-speech tool supporting 300+ voices across multiple languages and accents. It integrates with OpenAI, EdgeTTS, and other compatible APIs, offering real-time preview, adjustable speech rate/pitch, long-text segmentation, history tracking, and custom API configuration. Deployable via Vercel or Cloudflare Pages for private TTS solutions.

repos.description: [Unmaintained] An easy to use material design based framework.
repos.summary_zh: Material Framework 是一个轻量级、纯 CSS 实现的 Material Design 前端框架，提供完整的组件样式与响应式布局支持，适用于快速构建现代化网页应用，依赖 Google Material Design 图标与自定义配色方案。
repos.summary_en: Material Framework is a lightweight, CSS-only implementation of Material Design, offering complete component styling and responsive layouts for rapid development of modern web applications, leveraging Google's Material Design Icons and custom color schemes.

repos.description: Hexo七牛同步插件
repos.summary_zh: Hexo七牛同步插件是一个专为Hexo博客设计的自动化工具，支持将本地静态资源（图片、JS、CSS）自动同步至七牛云存储，无需手动上传。通过配置实现一键部署，支持图片处理、缩略图生成及离线预览，提升博客资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

repos.summary_zh: bestK/tv 是一个基于 Next.js 的现代化电视直播应用，支持多源直播流聚合、频道分类与搜索功能，提供响应式界面与 EdgeOne Pages 一键部署，适用于构建个人或社区级 IPTV 平台。
repos.summary_en: bestK/tv is a modern TV streaming app built with Next.js, featuring multi-source live stream aggregation, channel categorization, and search functionality. It offers a responsive interface and one-click deployment via EdgeOne Pages, ideal for building personal or community IPTV platforms.

repos.description: 快速、明确、极简
repos.summary_zh: 妹Blog v2 是一款基于 PHP+MySQL 的极简静态博客系统，采用 iTorr.JS 和 Q.JS 框架实现前后端分离，支持 Markdown 写作、代码高亮、多用户、分类管理、原生评论及多说集成，并针对 SAE/Hostker 云环境优化部署，提供缓存、模板与静态化加速，适合追求快速搭建与内容优先的个人博客。
repos.summary_en: Imouto v2 is a minimalist static blog system built with PHP+MySQL, leveraging iTorr.JS and Q.JS for frontend-backend separation. It supports Markdown writing, syntax highlighting, multi-user management, categories, native and Duoshuo comments, and is optimized for cloud platforms like SAE and Hostker. Features include caching, templating, static generation, and AJAX search for fast content delivery.

repos.description: Django project template layout
repos.summary_zh: django-layout 是一个基于最佳实践的 Django 项目模板，提供开箱即用的现代化开发体验。集成 uv 依赖管理、ruff/prettier 代码规范、goodconf 环境配置、结构化日志、TailwindCSS 样式方案、pytest 测试框架及 mypy 类型检查，支持 Docker 部署，显著提升 Django 项目初始化效率与生产环境健壮性。
repos.summary_en: django-layout is a modern Django project template offering sane defaults based on best practices. It integrates uv for dependency management, ruff/prettier for linting, goodconf for config, structured logging, TailwindCSS, pytest with coverage, mypy for type safety, and production-ready settings via Docker, streamlining Django project setup and deployment.

repos.description: a simple but powerful tool for validating form fields.  support bootstrap and your own styles.
repos.summary_zh: SMValidator 是一个轻量、无依赖的前端表单验证工具，支持通过 HTML 属性或 JavaScript 配置验证规则，兼容 Bootstrap 和 Semantic UI 样式，支持正则表达式和自定义函数验证，兼容 IE8+，提供灵活的错误提示与样式定制能力。
repos.summary_en: SMValidator is a lightweight, dependency-free form validation tool that supports rule configuration via HTML attributes or JavaScript. It integrates with Bootstrap and Semantic UI, supports RegExp and custom function validation, and is compatible with IE8+, offering flexible error messaging and styling options.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个现代化的个人作品集网站，基于 Next.js、Tailwind CSS 和 TypeScript 构建，采用严格模式开发。支持 Markdown/MDX 内容发布，集成 RSS 订阅、站点地图、评论系统和阅读量统计，结合 Motion 实现流畅的滚动动画与视图过渡，性能优化出色，Lighthouse 评分接近完美，适用于开发者展示个人项目与技能。
repos.summary_en: A modern personal portfolio website built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript (strict mode). Features Markdown/MDX content publishing, RSS feed, sitemap, comment system, reading time, and view counter. Includes scroll-based animations via Motion for smooth UX, with near-perfect Lighthouse scores in performance, accessibility, and SEO. Ideal for developers to showcase projects and skills.

repos.description: AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，使用 **FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]** 前沿模型提供强大的图像编辑功能，支持Stripe支付，注册登录，积分系统等，代码100%开源。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 15 构建的现代化 AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，集成前沿 FLUX.1 Kontext Pro 模型，支持智能编辑、背景移除、多格式输出及 Stripe 支付，提供完整的用户认证、积分系统和国际化支持，代码完全开源。
repos.summary_en: A modern AI image editing web app built with Next.js 15, powered by the cutting-edge FLUX.1 Kontext Pro model. Features intelligent editing, background removal, multi-format support, Stripe payments, user authentication, points system, and full internationalization, with 100% open-source code.

repos.description: Think of it as flatpages for small bits of reusable content you might want to insert into your templates and manage from the admin interface.
repos.summary_zh: django-chunks 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，提供类似 flatpages 的可复用内容块管理功能。通过简单的模型和模板标签，开发者可在后台管理界面创建命名内容块（如 'home_page_left'），并在模板中动态插入，支持富文本编辑，适用于需要多区域内容管理的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-chunks is a lightweight Django app that enables reusable content blocks similar to flatpages. It provides a model and template tag to manage named content chunks via the admin interface, allowing dynamic insertion into templates with rich text editing support—ideal for sites requiring multiple editable content areas.

repos.description: Generates Unique (& Unicode) slugs in Django Edit Add topics
repos.summary_zh: Django Uuslug 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的 slug 生成工具，核心功能是确保生成的 URL 标识符既支持 Unicode 字符又具备唯一性。它通过智能截断、分隔符控制和停用词过滤，适用于多语言内容管理系统、博客平台和电商网站等需要友好 URL 的场景。
repos.summary_en: Django Uuslug is a Django-specific slug generator that guarantees both Unicode support and uniqueness for URLs. It intelligently truncates, handles separators, and filters stopwords, making it ideal for multilingual CMS, blogs, and e-commerce sites requiring clean, readable URLs.

repos.description: WordPress look and feel for Django administration panel
repos.summary_zh: Django WP Admin 为 Django 管理后台提供 WordPress 风格界面，支持响应式设计、可折叠侧边栏、Font Awesome 图标及9种配色主题，兼容 Python3 与多 Django 版本，显著提升后台操作体验。
repos.summary_en: Django WP Admin delivers a WordPress-inspired interface for Django's admin panel, featuring responsive design, collapsible menus, Font Awesome icons, 9 color themes, and Python3 compatibility across multiple Django versions for enhanced usability.

repos.description: Another opensource blog system  based on Django1.6
repos.summary_zh: 基于Django1.6开发的开源个人博客系统，支持文章、分类管理，支持RST/HTML/Markdown格式写作，集成多说评论、RSS和微信自动回复，采用xadmin后台，提供Ansible一键部署方案，适合学习Django开发实践与博客搭建。
repos.summary_en: An open-source personal blog system built with Django 1.6, featuring article management, support for RST/HTML/Markdown content, integration with Duoshuo comments, RSS, and WeChat auto-reply. Includes xadmin backend and Ansible deployment script for easy setup and learning.

repos.description: A simple theme for Hexo
repos.summary_zh: hexo-theme-Daily 是一个简洁优雅的 Hexo 主题，专为版本 4.x 设计，提供现代化的博客展示体验。支持 SASS 渲染，兼容 IE9+，内置完整文档和演示站点，适合个人或团队快速搭建美观静态博客。
repos.summary_en: hexo-theme-Daily is a clean and modern theme for Hexo (v4.x), featuring simple design and full compatibility with IE9+. It supports SASS rendering, includes demo sites, documentation, and is ideal for building elegant static blogs quickly.

repos.description: A simple theme for Hexo
repos.summary_zh: hexo-theme-Daily 是一个简洁优雅的 Hexo 主题，专为版本 4.x 设计，提供现代化的博客展示体验。支持 SASS 渲染、响应式布局，兼容 IE9+，并参考了 WordPress Daily 主题风格，适合个人技术博客或内容站点使用。
repos.summary_en: hexo-theme-Daily is a clean and modern theme for Hexo (v4.x), featuring responsive design, SASS support, and compatibility with IE9+. Inspired by the WordPress Daily theme, it offers a professional layout ideal for personal blogs or content sites.

repos.description: SnackBase is a Python/FastAPI-based BaaS providing auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security, authentication, enterprise OAuth/SAML, and comprehensive admin UI.
repos.summary_zh: SnackBase 是一个基于 Python/FastAPI 的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在作为 Supabase 的自托管替代方案。它提供自动生成的 REST API、多租户架构、行级安全（RLS）、企业级认证（OAuth/SAML）以及功能完备的 React 管理后台，支持 SQLite 与 PostgreSQL，助力开发者快速构建安全的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: SnackBase is an open-source, Python/FastAPI-based Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed as a self-hosted Supabase alternative. It offers auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security (RLS), enterprise authentication (OAuth/SAML), and a comprehensive React admin UI, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL for rapid enterprise application development.

repos.description: Audit log for your Django models
repos.summary_zh: django-audit-log 是一个 Django 模型审计日志库，提供用户追踪、变更记录和会话信息存储功能。支持 Django 1.6/1.7 及多版本 Python，通过中间件自动记录模型创建与修改操作，适用于需要完整操作历史追溯的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-audit-log is a Django model audit logging library that tracks user actions, changes, and session keys for model instances. It supports Django 1.6/1.7, South and Django 1.7 migrations, and both Python 2.x and 3.x, enabling full audit trails for data modifications in web applications.

repos.description: Get Inspired by the World's Greatest Artworks Every Time You Open a New Tab. Extension Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
repos.summary_zh: Artab 是一款浏览器扩展，每次打开新标签页时展示世界顶级艺术作品，为用户提供每日艺术灵感。支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox，基于现代前端技术栈开发，具备本地存储管理和跨浏览器兼容特性。
repos.summary_en: Artab is a browser extension that displays world-class artworks on every new tab, inspiring users with daily art inspiration. Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, it features modern frontend architecture with local storage and cross-browser compatibility.

repos.description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt.js 3 构建的小红书工具网站，支持图文视频内容浏览、评论导出及下载功能，集成多代理轮换与本地数据持久化，提供现代化 UI 与完整代理配置，适用于内容采集与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: A Nuxt.js 3-based tool for browsing, exporting, and downloading Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) content including images, videos, and comments. Features modern UI, multi-proxy support, local data persistence, and automated browser interactions via Playwright.

repos.description: person blog powered by flask
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flask 开发的个人博客系统，支持文章发布与展示，提供完整的用户认证与数据库管理功能。项目包含传统单应用结构和蓝图（Blueprint）分离结构两种实现方式，适合学习 Flask 基础与模块化开发。
repos.summary_en: A personal blog built with Flask, featuring article publishing, user authentication, and database management. Includes both monolithic and Blueprint-based modular architectures, ideal for learning Flask fundamentals and application structuring.

repos.description: Django template tag for rendering Page objects as Bootstrap pagination HTML
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 模板标签，用于将 Django 的 Page 对象渲染为兼容 Bootstrap 的分页 HTML。支持 Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x 版本，提供灵活的配置选项如页码范围、前后跳转链接等，适用于 Django 1.2+ 项目，现已归档不再维护。
repos.summary_en: This Django template tag renders Page objects into Bootstrap-compatible pagination HTML. It supports Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x, offers configurable options like page ranges and prev/next links, and is compatible with Django 1.2+. The project is now archived and no longer maintained.

repos.description: Django tools for building nonrel backends
repos.summary_zh: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
repos.summary_en: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. It includes base classes for custom backends, specialized field types (e.g., ListField, DictField), and admin integration to support Django's admin interface without JOINs.

repos.summary_zh: Augment2Api 是一个连接 Augment API 的中间件服务，提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口，支持 Claude3.7 和 Claude4 模型调用，具备流式输出、多 token 管理、Redis 存储及批量检测功能，但存在账号被封风险，需谨慎使用。
repos.summary_en: Augment2Api is a middleware service that connects to Augment API, offering OpenAI-compatible interfaces for Claude3.7 and Claude4 models with streaming support, multi-token management, and Redis storage, though it carries account ban risks and should be used cautiously.

repos.description: Django storage for 七牛云存储
repos.summary_zh: Django Qiniu Storage 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的七牛云存储后端存储库，支持通过标准 Django Storage API 无缝集成七牛云存储服务，适用于托管静态资源和用户上传文件，支持 HTTPS 访问和灵活的配置方式。
repos.summary_en: Django Qiniu Storage is a Django backend storage library for Qiniu Cloud Storage, enabling seamless integration with Django's Storage API to manage static files and user uploads via Qiniu's CDN, supporting HTTPS access and flexible configuration via environment variables or settings.

repos.description: Improved memcached cache backend for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-newcache 是 Django 的增强型 memcached 缓存后端，支持 pylibmc、键哈希/版本化/风味化、无限超时及雪崩防护。通过自动处理键格式、版本控制和命名空间隔离，提升缓存安全性与多环境兼容性，默认行为已优化，支持自定义键生成函数。
repos.summary_en: django-newcache is an enhanced memcached backend for Django, offering pylibmc support, key hashing/versioning/flavoring, infinite timeouts, and thundering herd mitigation. It auto-hashes keys for safety, uses versioning for cache invalidation, and adds flavor prefixes for environment isolation—all with sensible defaults and optional custom key functions.

repos.description: 《Django设计模式与最佳实践》2015年03月-基于Django 1.7
repos.summary_zh: 《Django设计模式与最佳实践》系统讲解Django 1.7下的模型设计模式与工程实践，涵盖规范化、类图建模、多文件模型拆分等核心模式，强调模型作为Django应用基石的重要性，适用于构建可维护的大型Web应用。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically covers Django 1.7 design patterns and best practices, focusing on model design including normalization, class diagrams, and modularization. It emphasizes models as the foundation of Django applications, enabling scalable and maintainable web development.

repos.description: 股票数据接口
repos.summary_zh: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
repos.summary_en: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.

repos.description: Seamless integration of Algolia into your Django project.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 项目与 Algolia 搜索服务的无缝集成，支持自动索引同步、自定义索引命名、字段预处理等功能，适用于实现高性能实时搜索与自动补全。兼容 Python 3.8+ 和 Django 4.x/5.x，提供完整的搜索、地理搜索、标签及多索引支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables seamless integration of Algolia Search API into Django projects, offering features like automatic indexing, custom index naming, field preprocessing, and support for geo-search and tagging. Compatible with Python 3.8+ and Django 4.x/5.x, it simplifies building high-performance real-time search and autocomplete experiences.

repos.description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
repos.summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
repos.summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

repos.description: A super blog lite -- just one page. use vue with github api !
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GitHub Issue 的单页极简博客系统，使用 Vue 和 GitHub API 构建，支持自定义配置与 CI/CD 自动化部署，适合个人知识管理与轻量级内容展示。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

repos.description: Get a better UI of V2EX.
repos.summary_zh: v2ex.k 是一款专为 V2EX 设计的界面增强浏览器插件，采用 Vue 重构，提供全新配色、左侧导航栏和快速阅读模式。支持主题切换、全键盘操作及 URL 动态更新，显著提升浏览效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: v2ex.k is a browser extension that enhances the V2EX website with a modern UI, featuring new themes, sidebar navigation, quick-read mode, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic URL updates for improved browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: Easy PJAX for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-easy-pjax 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级应用，通过智能模板切换实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它自动根据请求头选择基础模板，支持缓存清理与 URL 净化，无需修改视图或 URL 配置，集成简单且兼容性强。
repos.summary_en: django-easy-pjax is a lightweight Django app that enables PJAX support by intelligently switching templates to enable partial page loads without full reloads. It auto-selects base or PJAX-specific templates based on HTTP headers, supports cache-busting cleanup, and requires no view or URL changes, making integration seamless and non-intrusive.

repos.description: It is a materializecss.com implementation with Vue.js.
repos.summary_zh: material-ui-vue 是一个基于 Vue.js 的 MaterializeCSS 组件库实现，提供 Material Design 风格的 UI 组件封装。支持通过 npm 安装，需配合 MaterializeCSS 资源文件使用，适用于快速构建现代化前端界面，但当前版本为试验性质，稳定性未经验证。
repos.summary_en: material-ui-vue is a Vue.js implementation of MaterializeCSS, offering Material Design UI components. It can be installed via npm and requires MaterializeCSS assets including CSS, JS, and jQuery. Designed for rapid development of modern web interfaces, though marked as unstable and not recommended for production use.

repos.description: 著名紫薇排盘工具iztro的python版本，用法和原版完全一致
repos.summary_zh: py-iztro 是著名紫微排盘工具 iztro 的 Python 版本，完全复刻原版功能，支持通过公历日期和性别生成详细的紫微斗数命盘，包含星曜分布、五行局等信息，采用 pydantic 进行数据建模，确保类型安全与代码可维护性。
repos.summary_en: py-iztro is a Python reimplementation of the renowned iztro astrology tool, offering identical functionality to the original JavaScript version. It generates comprehensive Ziwei Dou Shu charts using solar dates and gender, with full Pydantic-based data modeling for type safety and maintainability.

repos.description: Building WebApp in Android way.
repos.summary_zh: Jndroid 是一个 JavaScript 框架，允许开发者以 Android 原生应用的方式构建 WebApp。它通过提供类似 Android 的 UI 组件（如 TextView）和 setContentView 等 API，简化了 Web 应用的开发流程，适用于需要跨平台或移动端体验优化的场景。
repos.summary_en: Jndroid is a JavaScript framework enabling WebApp development in an Android-like manner. It provides Android-style UI components (e.g., TextView) and APIs like setContentView, simplifying cross-platform mobile web app development with native-like structure.

repos.description: Hugo theme for engineering documentation
repos.summary_zh: OINK是一款面向工程文档的本地优先Hugo主题，通过单次构建将原生Markdown转化为完整的知识发布站点，内置搜索、图表、数学公式等组件，无需Node.js或CDN，同时支持AI代理索引、多语言及渐进增强。
repos.summary_en: OINK is a local-first Hugo theme for engineering documentation that transforms native Markdown into a complete knowledge site with one build. It bundles search, diagrams, and math locally without Node.js or CDN, and supports AI agent indexing, multilingual routing, and progressive enhancement.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: A jquery and bootstrap basic tree view plugin, easily use.
repos.summary_zh: EasyTree 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Bootstrap 3 的轻量级树形视图插件，可将无序列表快速转换为支持选择、添加、编辑和删除操作的交互式树形结构，适用于需要动态层级数据管理的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: EasyTree is a lightweight jQuery and Bootstrap 3-based plugin that transforms unordered lists into interactive tree views with selectable, addable, editable, and deletable nodes, ideal for dynamic hierarchical data management in web applications.

repos.description: A full blog system based on Django
repos.summary_zh: GeekBlog是一个基于Django 1.6.5构建的全功能博客系统，集成MySQL和MongoDB双数据库，支持UEditor富文本编辑、多说评论、移动端适配及静态资源优化。通过django-admin-tools深度定制后台管理界面，具备完整的Feed和Sitemap功能，适合技术博主部署个人站点。
repos.summary_en: GeekBlog is a full-featured blog system built on Django 1.6.5, utilizing MySQL and MongoDB for data storage. It features UEditor rich text editing, Duoshuo comments, mobile responsiveness, and static asset optimization via Django Pipeline. The backend is enhanced with django-admin-tools for improved admin experience, supporting feeds and sitemaps for SEO.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django 项目提供基于 Bootstrap 3 的日期时间选择器组件，集成 Eonasdan 的 bootstrap-datetimepicker 插件，支持通过 moment.js 进行灵活的时间格式化，适用于表单中的日期和 datetime 字段输入，自动适配当前语言环境。
repos.summary_en: This Django package integrates the Bootstrap 3 datetimepicker widget (v2) by Eonasdan, enabling date and datetime field inputs in forms with moment.js-based formatting. It auto-detects the current language and requires Bootstrap 3 and jQuery. Compatible with Django 1.3+ and Python 2.4+.

repos.description: weui sketch by ZTfer
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

repos.description: A simple django app to use emojis on your website ⛺
repos.summary_zh: django-emoji 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于在网站中便捷地渲染表情符号。它支持将文本中的 :emoji: 标记自动转换为 Unicode 字符或图片，并提供 HTML 实体转换功能，适用于提升用户交互体验的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-emoji is a lightweight Django app that enables easy emoji rendering on websites. It automatically converts :emoji: text patterns into Unicode or image tags, with support for HTML entity conversion, ideal for enhancing user engagement in web applications.

repos.description: Django Brake - a versatile ratelimiting app for Django.
repos.summary_zh: Django Brake 是一个为 Django 框架设计的速率限制应用，支持基于 IP 地址或请求字段（GET/POST）的灵活限流策略。它提供装饰器接口，可阻止超限请求或标记请求状态，适用于登录防护、API 保护等场景，兼容 Django 1.3+ 并支持多时间阈值与路径级限流。
repos.summary_en: Django Brake is a versatile rate-limiting app for Django that uses decorators to limit views based on IP or request fields (GET/POST). It supports blocking or annotating exceeded requests, with configurable time thresholds and path-based buckets. Designed as a maintained fork of Django Ratelimit, it enhances flexibility for login protection and API security.

repos.description: A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
repos.summary_zh: Django Persistent Messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，提供持久化用户消息/通知功能。支持认证用户将消息存储在数据库中，实现跨会话的‘粘性’提醒，直到用户标记为已读。未认证用户仍使用会话存储。统一 API 支持屏幕显示和邮件通知，兼容 Django 原生消息系统。
repos.summary_en: Django Persistent Messages is a Django app extending the built-in messages framework to support persistent user notifications. It stores messages in the database for authenticated users, enabling sticky reminders until marked read. Anonymous users use session storage. Offers unified API for display and email notifications, fully compatible with Django's native messaging system.

repos.description: Unified, persistent user messages with live notifications via SSE for Django.
repos.summary_zh: Django Monitio 是一个基于 Django 的消息通知系统，支持持久化存储和实时推送。它利用 Redis 和 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 实现消息的持久化与实时同步，兼容主流浏览器，适用于需要长期保留用户通知的场景。
repos.summary_en: Django Monitio is a unified, persistent messaging system for Django that stores messages in the database and delivers live updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Built on Redis and compatible with modern browsers, it enables real-time notifications while supporting both authenticated and anonymous users.

repos.description: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
repos.summary_zh: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

repos.description: This is a Django helper for @defunkt's jquery-pjax.
repos.summary_zh: django-pjax 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于集成 jQuery-PJAX 实现页面局部异步加载，提升用户体验并保持浏览器历史记录。支持函数视图和类视图装饰器，自动替换模板为 `-pjax` 后缀版本，兼容 Python 2.7+/3.3+ 和 Django 1.3+。
repos.summary_en: django-pjax is a Django helper library that integrates jQuery-PJAX for partial page loading via AJAX, enhancing performance while maintaining browser navigation. It supports decorators for function and class-based views, auto-swapping templates to `-pjax` variants, compatible with Python 2.7+/3.3+ and Django 1.3+.

repos.description: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
repos.summary_zh: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
repos.summary_en: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

repos.description: bootstrap3 validation
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

repos.description: Materializecss for Django Form
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为 Django 表单集成 MaterializeCSS 样式的轻量级模板标签库，支持自动渲染表单字段并应用 Material Design 风格，提供图标、自定义尺寸和日期时间选择器等功能，简化了响应式表单的开发流程。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight Django template tag library that integrates MaterializeCSS styling into forms, enabling automatic rendering with Material Design aesthetics, including icons, custom grid sizes, and datetime pickers for streamlined responsive form development.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

repos.description: Nuxt full-stack blog.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt 的全栈博客系统，采用 MongoDB 存储、Cloudflare R2 图片存储和 Zeabur PaaS 部署，集成全文搜索、Markdown 编辑器、友链截图生成、评论系统等功能，支持 SEO 优化与主题切换，显著降低服务器成本。
repos.summary_en: A full-stack blog built with Nuxt, MongoDB, and Cloudflare R2, deployed on Zeabur PaaS. Features include full-text search, Markdown editor, friend link screenshot generation, Giscus comments, SEO optimization, and theme switching, reducing server costs by consolidating backend logic into Nuxt.

repos.description: v2ex 的 Material design 风格 CSS
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 V2EX 论坛提供 Material Design 风格的自定义 CSS 主题，通过注入样式实现现代化视觉升级，支持 Chrome 浏览器，用户可通过自定义 CSS 功能一键应用，显著提升界面美观度与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a Material Design-styled CSS theme for V2EX forum, enabling a modern visual upgrade through custom CSS injection. It supports Chrome browsers and allows users to apply the theme instantly via the custom CSS setting, enhancing UI aesthetics and user experience.

repos.description: :zap: :rocket:This is a upload plug-ins
repos.summary_zh: lUpload 是一个基于 jQuery 开发的轻量级文件上传插件，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择三种上传方式，具备实时进度显示、速度监控、多文件队列/并发上传控制，并可自定义文件类型缩略图与模板。适用于需要快速集成多模式上传功能的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: lUpload is a lightweight jQuery-based file upload plugin supporting drag-and-drop, paste, and file selection uploads. It features real-time progress tracking, upload speed monitoring, concurrent/sequential upload modes, custom thumbnails per file type, and flexible templating. Ideal for rapid integration of multi-mode uploads in web applications.

repos.description: A calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Tab 是一款基于 Chrome MV3 的本地优先新标签页仪表盘，将浏览器首页替换为安静、美观的个人工作台。集成时间显示、待办事项、常用网站、最近访问、便签、天气和音乐等功能，支持本地搜索、网页搜索与 AI 入口切换。核心数据默认存储于本机，无需注册登录，注重隐私保护，界面设计克制且中文体验友好，适合追求高效与专注的用户。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Tab is a calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard that transforms your browser's homepage into a minimalist personal workspace. It integrates time display, to-do lists, frequently used sites, recent history, sticky notes, weather, and music—all rendered locally without requiring an account. With support for local, web, and AI search, it emphasizes privacy, performance, and a distraction-free experience tailored for Chinese users.

repos.description: Source code to dannysite.com
repos.summary_zh: DannySite 是一个基于 Django 框架开发的个人网站，包含博客、图片展示、账户管理等功能，支持邮件注册、密码重置、RSS 订阅及富文本编辑。采用 django-simple-captcha 和 DjangoUeditor 等第三方库，UI 设计版权归作者所有，建议查看 dannysite4 获取最新版本。
repos.summary_en: DannySite is a personal website built with Django, featuring blog, image gallery, and user account management with email registration, password reset, RSS feeds, and rich text editing via UEditor. It uses third-party packages like django-simple-captcha and DjangoUeditor. UI design is copyrighted by the author. Check dannysite4 for the latest version.

repos.description: Qiniu(http://www.qiniu.com) is a cloud storage service, this package interages it with django framework.
repos.summary_zh: django-qiniu 是一个过时的 Django 插件，用于将七牛云存储服务集成到 Django 框架中。它通过自定义字段（如 QiniuFileField 和 QiniuImageField）简化文件上传与管理，支持自动生成文件 URL 和图像缩略图处理。需配合七牛 Python SDK 使用，现已不推荐使用，建议迁移至更现代的 django-qiniu-storage 方案。
repos.summary_en: django-qiniu is an outdated Django package that integrates Qiniu cloud storage with Django. It provides custom fields like QiniuFileField and QiniuImageField for seamless file uploads, URL generation, and image processing (e.g., thumbnails). Requires the Qiniu Python SDK and is no longer maintained; modern alternatives like django-qiniu-storage are recommended.

repos.summary_zh: django-pjaxr 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级扩展，通过集成 jquery-pjaxr 实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它通过模板标签和上下文处理器简化配置，支持自定义模板，适用于需要局部刷新的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-pjaxr is a lightweight Django extension enabling PJAX support via jquery-pjaxr, allowing seamless partial page updates without full reloads. It simplifies integration with template tags and context processors, supporting customizable templates for enhanced user experience in Django web applications.

repos.description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: Python implementation of the (inactive) HTML JSON Forms spec.
repos.summary_zh: html-json-forms 是一个 Python 实现的 HTML JSON Forms 规范库，用于通过传统 HTML 表单提交结构化 JSON 数据。它采用数组式命名约定（如 items[0][name]），支持嵌套对象解析，兼容 Django REST Framework，提供功能函数与序列化器集成，适用于前后端分离场景下的表单数据处理。
repos.summary_en: html-json-forms is a Python implementation of the HTML JSON Forms specification, enabling structured JSON submission via traditional HTML forms using array-style naming (e.g., items[0][name]). It supports nested object parsing, integrates with Django REST Framework via JSONFormSerializer, and provides both functional parsing and DRF-compatible serializers for complex form data handling.

repos.description: django最佳实践 项目目录结构布局
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供 Django 最佳实践的项目目录结构布局，推荐采用分层结构：apps 存放功能模块，configs 管理各类服务配置（如 Gunicorn、Nginx），deploy 包含自动化部署脚本，settings 按环境分离配置，static 和 templates 分别管理静态资源与模板文件。同时建议用 Gunicorn 替代 Apache、Celery + Redis 处理异步任务、MongoDB 替代传统 SQL 数据库，并推荐使用 TastyPie 构建 REST API。
repos.summary_en: This project presents Django best practices for directory structure, recommending a modular layout with apps for functionality, configs for service setups (Gunicorn, Nginx), deploy for deployment scripts, settings per environment, and static/templates for assets. It also advises using Gunicorn over Apache, Celery+Redis for async tasks, MongoDB for schema flexibility, and Django-TastyPie for REST APIs.

repos.description: A fault-tolerant pylibmc cache backend for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-ft-cache 是一个为 Django 设计的容错 pylibmc 缓存后端，通过 FaultTolerantCacheMixin 机制在缓存操作失败时记录日志而非抛出异常，避免因缓存故障导致应用崩溃，提升系统稳定性。
repos.summary_en: django-ft-cache is a fault-tolerant pylibmc cache backend for Django that catches and logs cache failures instead of raising exceptions, preventing application crashes due to cache issues and improving system resilience.

repos.description: My independent fork of django-persistent-messages. A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
repos.summary_zh: django-persistent-messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，为认证用户提供持久化消息存储，支持消息标记已读、删除和回复，同时为匿名用户保留会话级消息功能，实现统一的消息管理接口。
repos.summary_en: Django Persistent Messages extends Django's messaging framework to provide persistent message storage for authenticated users via database, with features like mark-as-read, delete, and reply. Anonymous users retain session-based messages. Offers a unified API combining persistent and temporary messaging.

repos.description: MOVED TO https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库已迁移至新地址，原项目不再维护。新的 django-avatar 项目由 jezdez 维护，提供 Django 应用的用户头像管理功能，支持图片上传、裁剪和显示，适用于需要用户头像功能的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: This repository is outdated - the new one is at https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar. The new django-avatar project by jezdez provides user avatar management for Django apps, supporting image upload, cropping, and display for web applications requiring user profile pictures.

repos.description: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
repos.summary_zh: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
repos.summary_en: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

repos.description: django动态生成百度地图。
repos.summary_zh: djangoBaidusitemap 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于动态生成百度地图 XML 站点地图，支持 HTML5、WML 和 XHTML 多格式 URL 输出，兼容 Django 内置 sitemap 机制，适用于 SEO 优化与多终端内容分发。
repos.summary_en: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.

repos.description: Integrate awesome Bleach library into Django
repos.summary_zh: django-bleach 是一个 Django 应用，用于将 Bleach 库集成到项目中，实现对用户提交的 HTML 内容进行安全过滤和净化。它提供模型字段、表单字段和模板过滤器三种使用方式，支持自定义允许的标签、属性和样式，防止 XSS 攻击，适用于需要富文本输入的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-bleach is a Django app that integrates the Bleach library to sanitize user-submitted HTML content. It offers model fields, form fields, and template filters for safe HTML processing, with customizable allowed tags, attributes, and styles to prevent XSS attacks in web applications requiring rich text input.

repos.description: django verify code
repos.summary_zh: DjangoVerifyCode 是一个用于 Django 框架的验证码生成库，支持英文单词和数字两种验证码模式，具备自适应字体尺寸的图片生成与校验功能，适用于网站用户身份验证场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoVerifyCode is a Django-based library for generating captcha images with English words or numbers, featuring adaptive font sizing and validation, ideal for user authentication in web applications.

repos.description: Middleware that sets a base template name on the context
repos.summary_zh: django-pjax-middleware 是一个 Django 中间件，用于在 PJAX 请求中自动设置基础模板名称，简化了 PJAX 页面的模板继承结构。它支持自定义基础模板和 PJAX 模板名称，并通过版本控制机制确保布局更新时触发完整页面重载，提升用户体验。
repos.summary_en: django-pjax-middleware is a Django middleware that automatically sets the base template name in PJAX requests, simplifying template inheritance for PJAX-enabled pages. It supports custom base and PJAX-specific templates, and uses versioning to force full page reloads when layout changes occur, enhancing user experience.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.
